meta.source: E:/單字 音檔逐字稿（Hackers TOEIC Vocabulary）

days.theme: 教材字彙・基礎 550–650 第 1 群

items.colloc: draw attention 吸引注意 | draw a conclusion 得出結論
items.distinct: attract 吸引人事物 | sketch 素描
ex: This new campaign will draw many customers.
這項新活動將吸引許多客戶。
Please draw a diagram for the plan.
請為這個計畫畫一張草圖。
He tried to draw money from the bank.
他試圖從銀行提款。

items.colloc: finally decide 最終決定 | finally arrive 終於抵達
items.distinct: at last 終於（強調如釋重負） | eventually 最終（強調過程長）
ex: The report was finally completed this morning.
報告終於在今天早上完成了。
Management finally agreed to our new proposal.
管理層最終同意了我們的新提案。
We finally found a suitable office space.
我們終於找到了合適的辦公空間。

items.pos: v. 顯示；展示 | n. 展覽；演出
items.colloc: show interest 表現出興趣 | show improvement 呈現進步
items.distinct: demonstrate 演示；證明 | display 陳列
ex: The chart shows a rise in sales.
圖表顯示銷售額上升。
She will show the client our new prototype.
她將向客戶展示我們的新原型。
The trade show attracted many international buyers.
這場貿易展吸引了許多國際買家。

items.pos: adj. 公平的；合理的 | n. 展覽會
items.colloc: fair treatment 公平對待 | job fair 就業博覽會
items.distinct: just 正義的 | exhibition 展示會
ex: Every employee deserves a fair salary increase.
每位員工都應得到公平的加薪。
The company organized a local job fair.
公司舉辦了一場在地就業博覽會。
It is only fair to share the workload.
分擔工作量是合理的作法。

items.pos: adj. 各式各樣的；不同的
items.colloc: various reasons 各種原因 | various sizes 各種尺寸
items.distinct: diverse 多樣化的 | several 幾個
ex: We considered various options for the expansion.
我們考慮了擴張的各種方案。
Staff members have various backgrounds in marketing.
員工們在行銷方面有不同的背景。
There are various ways to improve productivity.
有很多方法可以提升生產力。

items.colloc: employee benefits 員工福利 | employee training 員工培訓
items.distinct: employer 雇主 | staff 全體員工
ex: The company values every employee equally.
公司同樣重視每一位員工。
New employees must attend the orientation session.
新進員工必須參加迎新會。
Employee satisfaction is vital to our success.
員工滿意度對我們的成功至關重要。

items.pos: n. 進步；進展 | v. 進行；進步
items.colloc: make progress 取得進展 | steady progress 穩定進展
items.distinct: process 過程 | development 發展
ex: The project is making steady progress daily.
該專案每天都有穩定的進展。
We need to monitor the progress of tasks.
我們需要監控工作任務的進度。
She hopes to progress in her career quickly.
她希望在事業上能快速進步。

items.pos: v. 承辦宴席；迎合需求
items.colloc: cater to the needs 滿足需求 | cater a party 承辦派對
items.distinct: satisfy 滿意 | provide 提供
ex: Our hotel can cater for large corporate events.
我們飯店可以承辦大型企業活動。
We must cater to the changing market trends.
我們必須迎合不斷變化的市場趨勢。
They will cater the dinner for the conference.
他們將為研討會提供餐飲服務。

items.colloc: concentrate on 專注於 | concentrate efforts 集中精力
items.distinct: focus 焦點；聚焦 | pay attention 注意
ex: Please concentrate on your current task list.
請專注於你目前的任務清單。
We should concentrate resources on the main project.
我們應將資源集中在主要專案上。
It is hard to concentrate in a noisy office.
在吵雜的辦公室裡很難專心。

items.colloc: make a payment 付款 | payment method 付款方式
items.distinct: fee 費用 | salary 薪資
ex: The payment is due by the end of month.
付款期限為月底前。
We accept various methods of payment online.
我們線上接受多種付款方式。
Please confirm the payment status with accounting.
請與會計部門確認付款狀態。

items.colloc: prepare for 準備 | prepare a report 準備報告
items.distinct: arrange 安排 | organize 組織
ex: Did you prepare the documents for the meeting?
你有為會議準備文件嗎？
The team is preparing for the upcoming audit.
團隊正在為即將到來的稽核做準備。
She started to prepare a detailed financial plan.
她開始著手準備一份詳細的財務計畫。

items.colloc: key to success 成功的關鍵 | achieve success 獲得成功
items.distinct: achievement 成就 | victory 勝利
ex: Hard work is essential for professional success.
努力工作對於職業成功至關重要。
The launch was a huge success for us.
這次產品發表對我們來說非常成功。
Their success depends on the new marketing strategy.
他們的成功取決於新的行銷策略。

items.colloc: temporary staff 臨時員工 | temporary solution 暫時方案
items.distinct: provisional 臨時的（有條件的） | permanent 永久的
ex: We hired a temporary assistant for the summer.
我們為了夏天聘請了一位臨時助理。
This is only a temporary fix for the bug.
這只是針對該程式錯誤的暫時修復。
The office will be closed for temporary repairs.
辦公室將因臨時維修而暫時關閉。

items.colloc: under construction 施工中 | construction site 建築工地
items.distinct: structure 結構 | building 建築物
ex: The new building is currently under construction.
新大樓目前正在施工中。
The construction project will take two years.
這個營建專案將耗時兩年。
Traffic is delayed due to road construction nearby.
由於附近的道路施工，交通受到延誤。

items.colloc: make a decision 做決定 | reach a decision 達成決定
items.distinct: choice 選擇 | judgment 判斷力
ex: Management has made a final decision today.
管理層今天做出了最終決定。
We need more data before reaching a decision.
我們需要更多數據才能做出決定。
The decision will affect our entire department.
這個決定將會影響我們整個部門。

items.colloc: product development 產品開發 | professional development 專業發展
items.distinct: progress 進步 | growth 成長
ex: The development of new software takes time.
新軟體的開發需要時間。
He is responsible for business development tasks.
他負責業務拓展的工作任務。
Ongoing training aids in professional development.
持續的培訓有助於專業發展。

items.pos: adj. 直接的 | v. 指導；指揮
items.colloc: direct contact 直接聯繫 | direct answer 直接的回答
items.distinct: straight 直的 | manage 管理
ex: Please send your questions to me direct.
請直接將問題發送給我。
The manager directs the team every morning.
經理每天早上指導團隊工作。
We need a direct route to the warehouse.
我們需要一條通往倉庫的直接路線。

items.pos: v. 處理；應付 | n. 把手
items.colloc: handle a complaint 處理投訴 | handle a situation 處理狀況
items.distinct: deal with 處理 | manage 管理
ex: She can handle the pressure of deadlines well.
她能很好地應對截止日期的壓力。
Please handle this delicate matter with care.
請小心處理這件棘手的事。
Our team is trained to handle customer inquiries.
我們的團隊受過處理客戶諮詢的訓練。

items.pos: n. 練習；慣例 | v. 練習
items.colloc: best practice 最佳實務 | business practice 商業慣例
items.distinct: exercise 運動；習題 | habit 習慣
ex: Regular practice helps improve your presentation skills.
規律的練習有助於提升簡報技巧。
This is a standard business practice in Asia.
這是亞洲常見的商業慣例。
We need to practice our pitch before tomorrow.
我們明天之前需要練習提案簡報。

items.colloc: provide information 提供資訊 | provide support 提供支援
items.distinct: supply 供應 | offer 主動提供
ex: The company will provide lunch for all staff.
公司將為所有員工提供午餐。
Please provide your email address for updates.
請提供您的電子郵件地址以接收更新。
The guide provides clear instructions for users.
這份指南為使用者提供了清晰的說明。

days.theme: 教材字彙・基礎 550–650 第 2 群

items.pos: n. 內容 | adj. 滿意的
items.colloc: content marketing 內容行銷 | table of contents 目錄
items.distinct: context 語境；上下文 | container 容器
ex: The report has valuable content for our team.
這份報告對我們團隊有珍貴的內容。
She seems content with the current salary.
她似乎對目前的薪水感到滿意。
Please review the content of the contract.
請檢視這份合約的內容。

items.pos: n. 遞送；交付；演說風格
items.colloc: delivery service 配送服務 | free delivery 免運費
items.distinct: distribution 分配；配銷 | shipment 裝運的貨物
ex: We expect the delivery by tomorrow afternoon.
我們預計明天下午收到貨物。
His delivery of the presentation was excellent.
他這次簡報的表達方式很出色。
The store offers free delivery on all orders.
該店提供所有訂單免費配送。

items.colloc: accounting department 會計部 | HR department 人力資源部
items.distinct: sector 行業；領域 | division 部門；分公司
ex: Our department is hiring a new assistant.
我們部門正在徵求一位新助理。
Please contact the marketing department directly.
請直接聯繫行銷部門。
Every department must submit a budget report.
每個部門都必須提交預算報告。

items.pos: n. 影響；衝擊 | v. 產生影響
items.colloc: have an impact on 對...有影響 | major impact 重大影響
items.distinct: influence 影響力（較長遠）| effect 結果；效果
ex: The new policy had a major impact on sales.
新政策對銷售額產生了重大影響。
Rising costs will impact our annual profit.
成本上升將影響我們的年度利潤。
We need to assess the environmental impact.
我們需要評估環境影響。

items.colloc: annual income 年收入 | disposable income 可支配收入
items.distinct: salary 薪水（定期）| revenue 營收（企業）
ex: She is looking for a steady source of income.
她正在尋找穩定的收入來源。
High income earners pay higher taxes.
高收入者繳納較高的稅金。
The company generates income from digital ads.
該公司透過數位廣告獲利。

items.pos: adj. 當地的；本地的 | n. 當地人
items.colloc: local business 本地企業 | local market 當地市場
items.distinct: regional 地區的 | domestic 國內的
ex: We decided to hire a local supplier.
我們決定僱用一家當地供應商。
The event attracted many local residents.
這場活動吸引了許多當地居民。
Support local businesses in your community.
請支持你社區裡的在地企業。

items.pos: adj. 專業的；職業的 | n. 專業人士
items.colloc: professional advice 專業建議 | professional development 職業發展
items.distinct: vocational 職業技術的 | expert 專家
ex: You should maintain a professional attitude.
你應該保持專業的態度。
She is a professional in the accounting field.
她是會計領域的專業人士。
We offer professional training for employees.
我們為員工提供專業訓練。

items.colloc: strictly prohibited 嚴格禁止 | strictly followed 嚴格遵守
items.distinct: severely 嚴重地 | precisely 精確地
ex: Smoking is strictly prohibited in the office.
辦公室內嚴格禁止抽菸。
The budget must be strictly followed.
預算必須被嚴格遵守。
These rules are strictly enforced by management.
管理層嚴格執行這些規則。

items.pos: adj. 清晰的；明確的 | v. 清除
items.colloc: clear instruction 明確指示 | clear understanding 清晰的理解
items.distinct: vivid 生動的 | transparent 透明的
ex: Please give me a clear explanation of this.
請對此給我一個明確的解釋。
The path needs to be cleared of snow.
這條路需要清除積雪。
It is clear that we need more staff.
顯然我們需要更多員工。

items.colloc: convince someone to do 說服某人做某事 | convince someone of 說服某人相信
items.distinct: persuade 勸說 | influence 影響
ex: I need to convince my boss to approve it.
我需要說服老闆批准這件事。
They convinced him of the project's value.
他們使他確信該專案的價值。
Nothing could convince her to change her mind.
沒什麼能說服她改變心意。

items.colloc: waiting area 等候區 | area of expertise 專長領域
items.distinct: region 地區（較大）| zone 區域（特定用途）
ex: The conference will be held in this area.
會議將在此地區舉辦。
She is an expert in the area of finance.
她是金融領域的專家。
Please keep the work area clean at all times.
請隨時保持工作區域整潔。

items.pos: v. 按；壓 | n. 新聞界；印刷
items.colloc: press release 新聞稿 | press conference 記者會
items.distinct: push 推 | squeeze 擠壓
ex: Press the green button to start the machine.
按下綠色按鈕啟動機器。
The press reported on the merger today.
媒體今天報導了這項合併案。
We will issue a press release next week.
我們下週將發布新聞稿。

items.colloc: announce the results 宣布結果 | officially announce 正式宣布
items.distinct: declare 宣告 | publish 發布（出版品）
ex: The manager announced the new company policy.
經理宣布了新的公司政策。
They will announce the winner tomorrow morning.
他們將於明早宣布獲勝者。
An email was sent to announce the change.
一封電子郵件被發出以宣布變更。

items.pos: adj. 出席的；現在的 | v. 呈現；簡報
items.colloc: present at the meeting 出席會議 | present an idea 提出想法
items.distinct: current 目前的 | offer 提供
ex: Most of the staff were present today.
大部分員工今天都有出席。
I need to present my proposal to the board.
我需要向董事會簡報我的提案。
He presented a summary of the quarterly report.
他呈現了季報的摘要。

items.pos: n. 紀錄；唱片 | v. /rɪˈkɔːrd/ 錄音；記載
items.colloc: keep a record 做紀錄 | set a record 破紀錄
items.distinct: log 日誌 | file 檔案
ex: Please keep a record of all your expenses.
請保留所有費用的紀錄。
The meeting will be recorded for later review.
會議將被錄音以便日後檢閱。
Our team set a new sales record this month.
我們團隊本月創下了新的銷售紀錄。

items.pos: n. 地址；演說 | v. 處理；對...演說
items.colloc: mailing address 通訊地址 | address the issue 處理問題
items.distinct: location 地點 | deal with 處理
ex: Please confirm your office address with us.
請與我們確認你的辦公室地址。
We need to address these concerns immediately.
我們需要立即處理這些疑慮。
The CEO will address the employees tomorrow.
執行長明天將對員工發表演說。

items.pos: v. 增加 | n. /ˈɪnkriːs/ 增長
items.colloc: increase in price 價格上漲 | significant increase 顯著增長
items.distinct: rise 上升 | expand 擴張
ex: We hope to increase sales by ten percent.
我們希望銷售額能增加百分之十。
There has been an increase in customer demand.
客戶需求出現了增長。
Rising demand will increase our production costs.
需求上升將增加我們的生產成本。

items.pos: v. 允許；准許 | n. /ˈpɜːrmɪt/ 許可證
items.colloc: work permit 工作許可證 | permit someone to do 允許某人做
items.distinct: allow 允許 | authorize 授權
ex: The rules do not permit personal calls here.
規定不允許在這裡打私人電話。
You need a parking permit to use this lot.
你需要停車證才能使用這個停車場。
Weather permitting, we will hold the event.
若天氣允許，我們將舉辦該活動。

items.pos: v. 攪拌；引起（情緒/活動）
items.colloc: stir up 激起；挑起 | create a stir 引起轟動
items.distinct: mix 混合 | incite 煽動
ex: Please stir the mixture until it is smooth.
請將混合物攪拌至平滑。
The new announcement stirred a lot of interest.
這項新公告引起了極大興趣。
His comments created a stir among the staff.
他的評論在員工中引起了轟動。

items.pos: n. 主題；科目 | adj. 受支配的 | v. 使服從
items.colloc: change the subject 轉換話題 | subject to change 可能會變動
items.distinct: topic 話題 | theme 主旨
ex: The subject of the meeting is the new budget.
會議的主題是關於新預算。
This schedule is subject to change without notice.
此行程表若有變更恕不另行通知。
English is a required subject for all students.
英文是所有學生的必修科目。

days.theme: 教材字彙・基礎 550–650 第 3 群

items.colloc: active member 會員 | take an active part in 積極參與
items.distinct: proactive 主動的 | energetic 精力充沛的
ex: She remains active in the local business community.
她在當地商業圈依然活躍。
The company is looking for an active participant.
公司正在尋找積極的參與者。
We need an active strategy to boost sales.
我們需要一個積極的策略來提升銷售。

items.colloc: friendly atmosphere 友好的氣氛 | create an atmosphere 營造氛圍
items.distinct: environment 環境 | mood 情緒
ex: The office has a professional and calm atmosphere.
辦公室有一種專業且冷靜的氣氛。
We aim to create a welcoming atmosphere for guests.
我們致力於為賓客營造熱情的氛圍。
The meeting atmosphere turned tense during the discussion.
討論期間會議的氣氛變得緊張。

items.colloc: convert into 轉換成 | convert currency 兌換貨幣
items.distinct: transform 外型轉變 | change 改變
ex: You can convert the document into a PDF file.
你可以將這份文件轉換成 PDF 檔。
The currency was converted at the current rate.
貨幣已按現行匯率進行兌換。
We plan to convert the old warehouse into offices.
我們計畫將舊倉庫改建成辦公室。

items.colloc: currently available 現有可用的 | currently under construction 施工中
items.distinct: presently 不久後；目前 | recently 最近
ex: The manager is currently attending a regional meeting.
經理目前正在參加區域會議。
Our product is currently out of stock online.
我們的產品目前在網路上缺貨。
We are currently reviewing the annual budget proposal.
我們目前正在審核年度預算提案。

items.colloc: especially important 特別重要 | especially for 專門為了
items.distinct: specially 專門地 | particularly 特別地
ex: This software is especially useful for small teams.
這款軟體對小型團隊特別有用。
We appreciate your support, especially during the crisis.
我們感謝您的支持，尤其是在危機期間。
The event was organized especially for our clients.
這次活動是專門為我們的客戶舉辦的。

items.pos: n. 經驗 | v. 經歷；體驗
items.colloc: work experience 工作經驗 | gain experience 獲得經驗
items.distinct: experiment 實驗 | expertise 專業技能
ex: The candidate has five years of marketing experience.
這位應徵者有五年行銷經驗。
Customers can experience our latest models today.
顧客今天可以體驗我們的最新型號。
We experienced some technical issues during the demo.
我們在演示過程中經歷了一些技術問題。

items.colloc: give feedback 給予回饋 | give a presentation 做簡報
items.distinct: offer 提供；提議 | provide 提供
ex: Please give me your feedback on the report.
請給我您對報告的回饋。
The CEO will give a speech at the ceremony.
執行長將在典禮上致詞。
Can you give us a discount on this order?
您能給我們這筆訂單一些折扣嗎？

items.colloc: long-term investment 長期投資 | make an investment 進行投資
items.distinct: asset 資產 | interest 利息
ex: The company made a major investment in technology.
公司在科技方面進行了一筆重大投資。
This project is a safe investment for our firm.
這個專案對我們公司來說是一項安全的投資。
We are analyzing the returns on our investment.
我們正在分析我們的投資報酬。

items.colloc: related to 與...相關 | related fields 相關領域
items.distinct: relative 相對的 | relevant 有關的
ex: Does this issue relate to the new policy?
這個問題跟新政策有關嗎？
We discussed topics related to international trade.
我們討論了與國際貿易相關的話題。
Please provide all documents related to the claim.
請提供所有與索賠相關的文件。

items.colloc: broadly speaking 大體上來說 | broadly defined 廣義定義
items.distinct: widely 廣泛地（範圍大）| generally 通常地
ex: Broadly speaking, the project is successful.
大體上來說，這個專案是成功的。
The term is broadly defined in this document.
該術語在此文件中被廣泛定義。
They agree broadly on the main objectives.
他們大體上同意主要的目標。

items.pos: n. 椅子；主席 | v. 主持
items.colloc: office chair 辦公椅 | chair a meeting 主持會議
items.distinct: seat 座位 | moderator 主持人
ex: She will chair the meeting tomorrow morning.
她將主持明天早上的會議。
Please replace the broken office chair.
請更換那張壞掉的辦公椅。
Who is going to chair the committee?
誰要擔任委員會的主席？

days.theme: 教材片語・基礎 550–650 第 1 群

items.colloc: make a copy of 影印一份... | make extra copies 多印幾份
items.distinct: photocopy 影印機影本 | duplicate 副本
ex: Could you please make a copy of this report?
你能幫我把這份報告影印一份嗎？
I need to make a copy for the accounting department.
我需要為會計部門做一份影印副本。
Please make a copy before you hand in the file.
繳交檔案之前請先影印一份。

items.colloc: depend on someone 依賴某人 | depend on the situation 取決於情況
items.distinct: rely on 依賴；信賴 | count on 指望
ex: Our success will depend on the marketing strategy.
我們的成功將取決於行銷策略。
The delivery time depends on your specific location.
配送時間取決於您的具體地點。
We cannot always depend on one single supplier.
我們不能總是依賴單一供應商。

items.colloc: have in common 有共同點 | nothing in common 毫無共同點
items.distinct: shared 分享的；共享的 | mutual 互相的
ex: Both companies have a lot in common culturally.
兩家公司在企業文化上有許多共同點。
We have nothing in common regarding our business goals.
我們在商業目標上毫無共同點。
They found they had much in common during the meeting.
會議中他們發現彼此有許多共同點。

items.colloc: make payment by check 以支票付款 | make payment online 線上付款
items.distinct: settle the bill 結帳 | pay off 還清債務
ex: Please make payment within thirty days of purchase.
請於購買後三十天內完成付款。
You can make payment through our secure portal.
您可以透過我們的安全入口網站付款。
Failure to make payment will result in a penalty.
未完成付款將會導致罰款。

items.colloc: book in advance 事先預訂 | payment in advance 預付
items.distinct: ahead of time 提前 | beforehand 事先
ex: Please notify us in advance if you cannot attend.
如果您無法出席請事先通知我們。
All tickets must be purchased in advance online.
所有票券都必須事先在網上購買。
It is better to prepare the slides in advance.
最好能事先準備好簡報投影片。

items.pos: phr. 代表；作為...的代理人
items.colloc: on behalf of the company 代表公司 | on behalf of the team 代表團隊
items.distinct: represent 代表 | in the name of 以...的名義
ex: I am signing this contract on behalf of my boss.
我正代表我的老闆簽署這份合約。
She accepted the award on behalf of the staff.
她代表員工接受了這項獎項。
The lawyer spoke on behalf of the accused client.
律師代表被告客戶發言。

items.colloc: pick up a package 領取包裹 | pick up a client 接客戶
items.distinct: collect 收集；領取 | gather 聚集
ex: I will pick up the documents from the reception.
我會去櫃檯領取文件。
The driver will pick up the guest at noon.
司機會在中午去接那位客人。
Please pick up your badge at the registration desk.
請在報到處領取您的識別證。

items.colloc: local custom 當地習俗 | business custom 商業習慣
items.distinct: habit 個人習慣 | tradition 傳統
ex: It is a custom to exchange business cards politely.
有禮貌地交換名片是一種商業習慣。
The company respects every local custom abroad.
該公司尊重在國外的每一項當地習俗。
Understanding business customs helps with international negotiations.
了解商業習慣有助於國際談判。

items.colloc: make a point 強調；主張 | the main point 主要重點
items.distinct: viewpoint 觀點 | argument 論點
ex: That is a good point for our next meeting.
那是我們下次會議的一個好觀點。
He made a point of arriving early for work.
他特別注意提早抵達工作崗位。
Please get straight to the point of your request.
請直接進入你請求的重點。

items.colloc: a quick fix 權宜之計 | a permanent fix 永久解決方案
items.distinct: repair 修理 | solution 解決方案
ex: We need a long-term fix for the software bug.
我們需要針對軟體錯誤提出長期的解決方案。
That is just a quick fix for the problem.
那只是該問題的一個權宜之計。
The technician provided a fix for the broken printer.
技術人員為故障的印表機提供了修理方案。

items.colloc: a long journey 長途旅行 | start a journey 開始旅程
items.distinct: trip 短程旅行 | voyage 海上航行
ex: The business journey to Tokyo was very productive.
前往東京的商務旅程非常有成效。
Our company began its journey over ten years ago.
我們公司是在十多年前開始發展歷程的。
It was a long journey from the office to the factory.
從辦公室到工廠是一段漫長的旅程。

items.colloc: fill in a form 填寫表格 | fill in the gaps 補齊空缺
items.distinct: fill out 填寫（全部資訊） | complete 完成
ex: Please fill in your name on the guest list.
請在訪客名單上填寫您的姓名。
Can you fill in for me at the board meeting?
你能幫我參加董事會議並補充說明嗎？
Fill in the required information on this document.
請在這份文件上填寫必要的資訊。

items.colloc: fill out an application 填寫申請表 | fill out the survey 填寫問卷
items.distinct: fill in 填寫（細節） | write down 寫下
ex: You need to fill out this form to apply.
你需要填寫這份表格來申請。
Please fill out the feedback survey before leaving today.
請在今天離開前填寫意見回饋問卷。
All employees must fill out their tax forms annually.
所有員工必須每年填寫稅務表格。

items.colloc: traditionally held 傳統上舉行 | traditionally associated 傳統上相關
items.distinct: customarily 慣例上 | conventionally 慣例地
ex: This industry is traditionally dominated by large corporations.
這個產業傳統上由大型企業主導。
The company meeting is traditionally held every January.
公司會議傳統上在每年一月舉行。
They traditionally provide bonuses at the end of year.
他們傳統上會在年底發放獎金。

items.colloc: in title only 僅有名義 | formal title 正式頭銜
items.distinct: by name 以名字 | on paper 在文件上
ex: He is the manager in title but has no authority.
他名義上是經理，但並沒有實權。
The position exists in title but remains vacant.
該職位僅有名義存在，但仍處於空缺狀態。
She is the owner in title of this small firm.
她名義上是這家小公司的負責人。

items.colloc: misplace a file 弄丟文件 | misplace the key 弄丟鑰匙
items.distinct: lose 遺失 | mislay 隨手放錯
ex: I seem to have misplaced the signed contract copy.
我似乎把簽署過的合約副本弄丟了。
Please do not misplace the important project documents.
請不要弄丟重要的專案文件。
He often misplaces his glasses during busy work hours.
他在忙碌工作時經常弄丟眼鏡。

items.colloc: a man of action 有執行力的人 | a man of experience 經驗豐富的人
items.distinct: staff 員工 | employee 受雇者
ex: He is a man of great integrity in business.
他在商場上是一位非常有操守的人。
We need a man for the maintenance team immediately.
我們現在需要一位男性加入維修團隊。
That man is the new consultant for our project.
那位先生是我們專案的新任顧問。

items.pos: v. 收費；充電 | n. 費用；負責
items.colloc: free of charge 免費 | in charge of 負責
items.distinct: fee 費用 | cost 成本
ex: The hotel will charge for the extra room service.
飯店會針對額外的客房服務收費。
Who is in charge of the training program?
誰負責這個培訓計畫？
There is no charge for the initial consultation service.
初次諮詢服務不收取任何費用。

items.pos: phr. 取得你的；得到你的
items.colloc: get your feedback 取得你的回饋 | get your approval 得到你的批准
items.distinct: receive 收到 | acquire 取得
ex: I need to get your signature on this document.
我需要你在這份文件上簽名。
Please get your reports ready by tomorrow morning.
請在明天早上前準備好你的報告。
I want to get your opinion on the new design.
我想聽聽你對新設計的看法。

items.colloc: issue an invoice 開發票 | settle the invoice 付清發票金額
items.distinct: receipt 收據 | bill 帳單
ex: Please send the invoice to our accounting department.
請將發票寄給我們的會計部門。
The invoice must match the total order amount.
發票金額必須與訂單總額相符。
I received the invoice for the supplies today.
我今天收到了這些物資的發票。

days.theme: 教材片語・進階 650–750 第 2 群

items.colloc: in this regard 在這方面 | with regard to 關於
items.distinct: in this respect 在這方面 | as for... 至於...
ex: We have no information in this regard.
我們關於這一點沒有任何資訊。
Please advise us in this regard immediately.
請就此事盡快給予我們建議。
No further action is needed in this regard.
關於這一點無需採取進一步行動。

items.colloc: find out the truth 找出真相 | find out information 查明資訊
items.distinct: discover 發現（本來就存在） | figure out 理解；想出解決方法
ex: I will find out when the flight arrives.
我會查明班機抵達的時間。
She wants to find out about our policy.
她想了解我們公司的政策。
Management needs to find out the cause of delay.
管理層需要查明延誤的原因。

items.colloc: clean up the office 清理辦公室 | clean up the mess 清理混亂
items.distinct: clear up 解釋清楚；消除誤會 | tidy up 收拾；整理
ex: Everyone should help to clean up the pantry.
每個人都應該幫忙清理茶水間。
We need to clean up the data before analysis.
分析前我們需要先整頓資料。
Staff members were asked to clean up their desks.
員工被要求清理各自的辦公桌。

items.zh: 頭等艙；一流的；最優質的
items.colloc: first class service 一流的服務 | first class ticket 頭等艙票
items.distinct: top-notch 頂尖的 | premium 高級的
ex: She booked a first class seat for the flight.
她預訂了飛行旅程的頭等艙座位。
The hotel is known for its first class service.
這家飯店以其一流的服務聞名。
We provide first class support to our clients.
我們提供客戶一流的支援服務。

items.colloc: do something right away 立刻做某事 | need it right away 急需
items.distinct: at once 立即 | immediately 立即
ex: Please process the order right away.
請立刻處理這份訂單。
I will send the report to you right away.
我會馬上把報告寄給你。
The manager wants to see you right away.
經理想要立刻見你。

items.colloc: apply for a job 應徵工作 | apply for a position 申請職位
items.distinct: apply to 應用於；向...申請 | request 要求
ex: She decided to apply for the marketing position.
她決定申請行銷職位。
You must apply for the visa before traveling.
旅行前你必須申請簽證。
Many candidates applied for the internship program.
許多候選人申請了實習計畫。

items.colloc: attend an award ceremony 參加頒獎典禮 | hold an award ceremony 舉辦頒獎典禮
items.distinct: opening ceremony 開幕典禮 | closing ceremony 閉幕典禮
ex: The award ceremony will start at two o'clock.
頒獎典禮將於兩點開始。
Please confirm your attendance at the award ceremony.
請確認是否出席頒獎典禮。
The CEO will speak at the annual award ceremony.
執行長將在年度頒獎典禮上致詞。

items.zh: 被建議做某事；宜做某事
items.colloc: be advised to arrive early 建議提早到達 | be advised to contact us 建議聯絡我們
items.distinct: be suggested that 建議（子句） | be recommended 被推薦
ex: Employees are advised to lock their computers.
建議員工將電腦鎖定。
You are advised to review the contract carefully.
建議您仔細審閱這份合約。
Visitors are advised to bring a valid ID.
建議訪客攜帶有效身分證件。

items.colloc: be aware of the risks 意識到風險 | be aware of the deadline 知道截止日期
items.distinct: be conscious of 有自覺的 | be familiar with 熟悉
ex: Are you aware of the new safety regulations?
你知道新的安全規定嗎？
The manager is fully aware of the situation.
經理完全了解目前的狀況。
Please be aware of the limited parking space.
請留意有限的停車空間。

items.colloc: be likely to succeed 很可能會成功 | be likely to change 很可能變動
items.distinct: be expected to 被預期會 | be prone to 易於（負面）
ex: Sales are likely to increase this quarter.
這季的銷售額很可能會成長。
The project is likely to be finished soon.
這個專案很可能很快會完成。
We are likely to reach our target by Friday.
我們很可能在週五前達成目標。

items.colloc: at the bus stop 在公車站 | near the bus stop 在公車站附近
items.distinct: bus station 客運轉運站 | subway station 地鐵站
ex: The bus stop is located across the street.
公車站就在街的對面。
We will meet you at the bus stop.
我們會在公車站與你會合。
Is there a bus stop near the hotel?
飯店附近有公車站嗎？

items.colloc: have a business talk 進行商務會談 | start a business talk 開始洽談業務
items.distinct: business meeting 商務會議 | business negotiation 商務談判
ex: We had a productive business talk this morning.
我們今天早上進行了一場很有成效的商務會談。
He is engaged in a business talk with partners.
他正在與合作夥伴進行商務會談。
They scheduled a business talk for next Tuesday.
他們將商務會談安排在下週二。

items.zh: 繁忙的街道；熱鬧的街道
items.colloc: on a busy street 在繁忙的街道上 | a busy street corner 繁忙的街角
items.distinct: crowded area 擁擠區域 | heavy traffic 交通繁忙
ex: The office is located on a busy street.
辦公室位於一條繁忙的街道上。
Parking is difficult on this busy street.
在這條繁忙的街道上停車很困難。
Many shops are opening on that busy street.
那條繁忙的街道上開了許多店鋪。

items.colloc: contact by telephone 以電話聯繫 | order by telephone 以電話訂購
items.distinct: over the phone 在電話中 | on the telephone 在講電話
ex: Please confirm the details by telephone.
請透過電話確認細節。
We can discuss the contract by telephone.
我們可以透過電話討論合約。
You may register for the seminar by telephone.
您可以透過電話報名研討會。

items.pos: n. 總公司；中心辦公室
items.colloc: report to the central office 向總公司報告 | contact the central office 聯繫總部
items.distinct: headquarters 總部 | branch office 分公司
ex: Documents must be sent to the central office.
文件必須送到總公司。
The central office is based in Taipei.
總公司設於台北。
I will check with the central office first.
我會先跟總公司確認。

items.colloc: order cleaning supplies 訂購清潔用品 | store cleaning supplies 存放清潔用品
items.distinct: office supplies 辦公用品 | maintenance tools 維修工具
ex: We are running low on cleaning supplies.
我們的清潔用品快用完了。
Please store the cleaning supplies in the closet.
請將清潔用品存放在壁櫥裡。
The cleaning supplies are provided by the company.
清潔用品由公司提供。

items.colloc: use the copy machine 使用影印機 | fix the copy machine 修理影印機
items.distinct: printer 印表機 | scanner 掃描器
ex: The copy machine is out of paper again.
影印機又沒紙了。
Please do not leave your documents on the copy machine.
請不要把文件留在影印機上。
We need to repair the office copy machine.
我們需要修理辦公室的影印機。

items.colloc: work at a department store 在百貨公司工作 | shop at a department store 在百貨公司購物
items.distinct: supermarket 超級市場 | mall 購物中心
ex: They are opening a new branch in the department store.
他們正在百貨公司裡開設一家新分店。
The department store holds a sale every summer.
百貨公司每年夏天都會舉辦特賣會。
She bought a new suit at the department store.
她在百貨公司買了一套新西裝。

items.colloc: meet the due date 準時完成 | extend the due date 延長截止日期
items.distinct: deadline 最後期限 | expiration date 到期日
ex: The due date for the report is Friday.
報告的截止日期是週五。
Please submit your project before the due date.
請在截止日期前提交您的專案。
We have to change the due date for payment.
我們必須更改付款的截止日期。

items.colloc: consume energy drinks 飲用能量飲料 | sell energy drinks 販售能量飲料
items.distinct: soft drink 軟性飲料 | sports drink 運動飲料
ex: Many employees drink energy drinks during overtime.
許多員工在加班時會喝能量飲料。
The new energy drink has become very popular.
這款新款能量飲料變得很熱門。
He avoids drinking energy drinks late at night.
他避免在深夜飲用能量飲料。

days.theme: 教材片語・進階 650–750 第 3 群

items.colloc: watch the evening news 收看晚間新聞 | report the evening news 報導晚間新聞
items.distinct: daily news 日報 | breaking news 即時新聞
ex: The evening news will start in ten minutes.
晚間新聞將在十分鐘後開始。
She discussed the report featured on the evening news.
她討論了晚間新聞報導的那則報告。
Make sure to record the evening news for the manager.
務必幫經理錄下晚間新聞。

items.colloc: visit a film studio 參觀製片廠 | work at a film studio 在製片廠工作
items.distinct: recording studio 錄音室 | art studio 美術工作室
ex: The actor visited the film studio for a rehearsal.
那位演員到電影製片廠進行彩排。
This film studio produces high-quality documentaries annually.
這家電影製片廠每年製作高品質紀錄片。
They are scouting locations near the local film studio.
他們正在當地電影製片廠附近尋找場地。

items.colloc: offer free parking 提供免費停車 | limited free parking 有限的免費車位
items.distinct: paid parking 付費停車 | valet parking 代客泊車
ex: The shopping mall provides free parking for all customers.
這家購物中心為所有顧客提供免費停車。
Guests staying at our hotel are entitled to free parking.
入住我們飯店的房客享有免費停車權益。
Please note that free parking is available on weekends only.
請注意僅在週末提供免費停車。

items.colloc: use a frying pan 使用平底鍋 | clean the frying pan 清洗平底鍋
items.distinct: saucepan 燉鍋 | baking sheet 烤盤
ex: Place the frying pan on the stove over medium heat.
將平底鍋放在爐子上以中火加熱。
The chef reached for a large frying pan to sauté vegetables.
主廚拿了一個大平底鍋來炒蔬菜。
This non-stick frying pan is easy to wash after cooking.
這款不沾平底鍋烹飪後很容易清洗。

items.colloc: stop at a gas station 在加油站停車 | work at a gas station 在加油站工作
items.distinct: service area 服務區 | charging station 充電站
ex: We need to stop at the gas station before the highway.
我們上高速公路前得先在加油站停車。
The gas station is currently undergoing major renovations.
該加油站目前正在進行重大整修。
He bought some snacks at the gas station convenience store.
他在加油站的便利商店買了一些零食。

items.colloc: expect to get a phone call 等待一通電話 | get a phone call from a client 接到客戶電話
items.distinct: make a phone call 打電話 | return a phone call 回電
ex: I expect to get a phone call from HR regarding my application.
我預計會接到人資關於我申請的電話。
Did you get a phone call from the regional manager today?
你今天有接到區域經理的電話嗎？
She had to leave the meeting to get a phone call.
她為了接一通電話不得不離開會議。

items.colloc: get used to the schedule 適應行程 | get used to the new software 習慣新軟體
items.distinct: be used to 已經習慣 | use to 過去曾經
ex: It takes time to get used to the new office environment.
適應新的辦公環境需要一些時間。
Employees are slowly getting used to the updated company policy.
員工們正在慢慢習慣更新後的公司政策。
I have finally gotten used to the morning commute time.
我終於習慣了早上的通勤時間。

items.colloc: in addition to that 除了那之外 | furthermore, in addition 此外
items.distinct: in addition 此外 | in addition to 除了...之外
ex: The software is fast; in addition, it is very user-friendly.
該軟體運行速度快；此外，它也非常易於使用。
We need more staff; in addition, we need better equipment.
我們需要更多員工；此外，我們還需要更好的設備。
The proposal is well-written; in addition, it is cost-effective.
這份企劃書寫得很好；此外，它具備成本效益。

items.colloc: in addition to the salary 除了薪水 | in addition to the project 除了專案
items.distinct: except for 除了...之外（不包含）| apart from 除了...之外
ex: In addition to the base salary, we offer performance bonuses.
除了基本薪資外，我們還提供績效獎金。
She speaks French in addition to her native language.
除了母語之外，她還會說法語。
In addition to the main presentation, we will host a Q&A.
除了主要簡報外，我們還會舉辦問答環節。

items.colloc: in case of emergency 緊急情況下 | in case of delay 若發生延誤
items.distinct: in case 以防萬一 | in the event of 如果發生
ex: In case of power failure, please use the emergency stairs.
如果發生停電，請使用緊急逃生梯。
Notify the manager in case of any technical problems.
如果發生任何技術問題，請通知經理。
Keep this document safe in case of a future audit.
請妥善保管這份文件，以備日後的審計。

items.colloc: in order to succeed 為了成功 | in order to improve 為了改善
items.distinct: so as to do 為了 | for the purpose of 為了
ex: We must cut costs in order to remain competitive.
我們必須削減成本以保持競爭力。
The team worked overtime in order to meet the deadline.
團隊為了趕上截止期限而加班。
They invested in training in order to boost productivity.
他們投資培訓以提升生產力。

items.colloc: in short, the plan failed 簡而言之，計畫失敗了 | to sum up, in short 總結來說
items.distinct: in brief 簡短地 | to be brief 簡單來說
ex: In short, we need to increase our marketing efforts.
簡而言之，我們需要加強行銷力道。
The results were poor; in short, we need a new strategy.
結果很差；總之，我們需要一個新策略。
In short, the project was completed ahead of schedule.
簡而言之，該專案提前完成了。

items.colloc: in total cost 總成本 | a total of 總數為
items.distinct: all in all 總而言之 | on the whole 整體而言
ex: There were twenty participants in total at the seminar.
研討會總共有二十位參加者。
The order will cost five hundred dollars in total.
這筆訂單總共花費五百美元。
We have collected fifty survey responses in total so far.
到目前為止，我們總共收集了五十份調查回覆。

items.colloc: currently in use 目前使用中 | keep it in use 繼續使用
items.distinct: out of use 停止使用 | for use 供使用
ex: This meeting room is currently in use by the finance team.
這間會議室目前由財務團隊使用中。
The old machinery is still in use at the factory.
那台舊機器目前在工廠仍在使用中。
Check if the printer is in use before sending files.
傳送檔案前請確認印表機是否在使用中。

items.colloc: wait just for a minute 等一下 | step out just for a minute 離開一分鐘
items.distinct: in a minute 立刻 | every minute 每分鐘
ex: Could you step outside just for a minute to discuss this?
你能出來一下談談這個嗎？
I will be ready to start the presentation just for a minute.
我只要一分鐘就能準備好開始簡報。
The manager was away just for a minute to get water.
經理離開一下去拿水，只需要一分鐘。

items.colloc: leave a message on the machine 在電話留言 | leave a message for the secretary 給秘書留言
items.distinct: send a message 傳送訊息 | write a note 寫便條
ex: If I am not at my desk, please leave a message.
如果我不在座位上，請留言給我。
She decided to leave a message for her supervisor.
她決定給主管留個口信。
Please leave a message after the beep on the answering machine.
請在聽到提示音後於答錄機上留言。

items.colloc: look after the business 照看生意 | look after the guest 招待賓客
items.distinct: take care of 處理/照顧 | look for 尋找
ex: Who will look after the office while you are traveling?
你出差時誰會負責照看辦公室？
He was hired to look after the company's financial records.
他被聘請來負責管理公司的財務紀錄。
The assistant will look after the clients during the event.
助理將在活動期間負責接待客戶。

items.loc: put on display 展示 | currently on display 目前展示中
items.distinct: on sale 特價中 | in stock 有庫存
ex: The new product designs are on display in the lobby.
新產品設計正在大廳展示中。
Several rare paintings are on display at the art gallery.
幾幅稀有畫作正在藝廊陳列展示。
Are these items currently on display for the customers?
這些商品目前有在為顧客進行展示嗎？

items.colloc: work on one zone 在某區域工作 | stay on one zone 待在區域內
items.distinct: in a zone 在區域中 | out of zone 超出範圍
ex: Each salesperson is assigned to focus on one zone.
每位銷售人員都被分配負責專注於一個區域。
We are currently working on one zone to improve efficiency.
我們目前正在特定區域工作以提升效率。
Please ensure all equipment stays on one zone for inventory.
請確保所有設備都留在同一個區域以便盤點。

items.colloc: go on vacation 去度假 | be on vacation 休假中
items.distinct: on leave 請假 | on business 出差
ex: The department head is currently on vacation until Friday.
部門主管目前休假直到星期五。
Many employees choose to go on vacation during the summer.
許多員工選擇在夏季期間去度假。
I am planning to be on vacation for two weeks in July.
我計畫在七月休假兩個星期。

days.theme: 教材片語・進階 650–750 第 4 群

items.colloc: obtain a parking pass 取得停車證 | display the parking pass 出示停車證
items.distinct: parking permit 停車許可證 | parking space 停車位
ex: Employees must display their parking pass at all times.
員工必須隨時展示他們的停車證。
Please show your parking pass to the security guard.
請向警衛出示您的停車證。
New parking passes will be distributed starting next Monday.
新的停車證將從下週一開始發放。

items.colloc: press the button firmly 用力按下按鈕 | press the button twice 按兩下按鈕
items.distinct: push the button 推動按鈕 | click the button 點擊按鈕（滑鼠）
ex: You need to press the button to open the gate.
你需要按下按鈕才能打開大門。
Simply press the button to start the printing process.
只需按下按鈕即可開始列印程序。
She had to press the button to alert the floor manager.
她必須按下按鈕來通知樓層經理。

items.colloc: visit a public park 參觀公園 | maintain a public park 維護公園
items.distinct: private garden 私人庭院 | national park 國家公園
ex: The city plans to renovate the old public park downtown.
市政府計畫翻修市中心的老舊公園。
They held the company picnic at a nearby public park.
他們在附近的公園舉辦了公司野餐。
This public park is open to all residents until sunset.
這座公園對所有居民開放至日落。

items.colloc: contact the public relations department 聯繫公關部 | head of the public relations department 公關部主管
items.distinct: human resources department 人力資源部 | marketing department 行銷部
ex: Direct all media inquiries to our public relations department.
將所有媒體詢問轉交給我們的公關部。
The public relations department released a formal statement today.
公關部今天發布了一份正式聲明。
She works as a manager in the public relations department.
她在公關部擔任經理。

items.colloc: put on a coat 穿上外套 | put on a show 上演節目
items.distinct: wear 穿著（狀態） | try on 試穿
ex: Please put on your safety goggles before entering the lab.
進入實驗室前請戴上護目鏡。
The team will put on a presentation for the clients.
團隊將為客戶進行一場簡報演示。
She needs to put on a professional suit for the interview.
她需要穿上一套專業套裝去面試。

items.colloc: analyze sales trends 分析銷售趨勢 | rising sales trend 上升的銷售趨勢
items.distinct: sales figure 銷售數字 | market trend 市場趨勢
ex: The report highlights a positive sales trend this quarter.
該報告強調了本季正向的銷售趨勢。
We must carefully examine the latest sales trend reports.
我們必須仔細檢視最新的銷售趨勢報告。
The recent sales trend indicates a decline in demand.
近期的銷售趨勢顯示需求有所下滑。

items.colloc: designated smoking section 指定吸菸區 | locate the smoking section 找到吸菸區
items.distinct: non-smoking area 非吸菸區 | lounge 休息室
ex: The restaurant provides a separate smoking section outdoors.
餐廳在戶外設有獨立的吸菸區。
Guests are required to use the designated smoking section.
客人必須使用指定的吸菸區。
Smoking is strictly prohibited outside the smoking section.
在吸菸區外嚴禁吸菸。

items.colloc: switch off the lights 關燈 | switch off the equipment 關閉設備
items.distinct: turn off 關掉 | power down 關機
ex: Remember to switch off your computer before leaving the office.
離開辦公室前記得關掉電腦。
Please switch off all electronic devices during the flight.
飛行期間請關閉所有電子設備。
He went back to switch off the main power supply.
他折返回去關掉主電源。

items.colloc: adjust the table lamp 調整桌燈 | buy a new table lamp 購買新桌燈
items.distinct: desk lamp 檯燈 | floor lamp 立燈
ex: The table lamp provides soft light for my work.
這盞桌燈為我的工作提供了柔和的光線。
I need a brighter table lamp for reading documents.
我需要一盞更亮的桌燈來閱讀文件。
She placed the table lamp on the corner of the desk.
她把桌燈放在書桌的角落。

items.colloc: make a telephone call 打電話 | receive a telephone call 接到電話
items.distinct: phone call 電話 | conference call 電話會議
ex: I received a telephone call from the regional manager.
我接到了區域經理的電話。
Please hold for a brief telephone call regarding the contract.
請稍候，有一通關於合約的電話。
He is currently busy on a telephone call with clients.
他目前正忙著與客戶通話。

items.colloc: think of a solution 想出解決方案 | think of you 想到你
items.distinct: think about 考慮（持續思考） | come up with 想出（創意）
ex: Can you think of a better way to organize the files?
你能想到整理檔案更好的方法嗎？
I often think of ways to improve our service quality.
我常思考如何提升我們的服務品質。
What do you think of the new marketing strategy?
你覺得新的行銷策略如何？

items.colloc: turn off the engine 關掉引擎 | turn off the tap 關上水龍頭
items.distinct: switch off 關掉（開關） | shut down 關機（系統）
ex: Please turn off the projector after the presentation ends.
簡報結束後請關掉投影機。
Did you turn off the air conditioner in the meeting room?
你有關掉會議室的冷氣嗎？
We should turn off the lights to save on electricity.
我們應該關燈來節省電力。

items.colloc: write down the instructions 寫下指示 | write down the details 記錄細節
items.distinct: take notes 做筆記 | record 錄音/記錄
ex: Please write down your contact information on this form.
請在這份表格上寫下您的聯絡資訊。
I will write down the important points of the meeting.
我會把會議重點記錄下來。
Did you write down the address before leaving the shop?
離開商店前你有把地址記下來嗎？

items.colloc: reply as soon as possible 儘快回覆 | process as soon as possible 儘快處理
items.distinct: at your earliest convenience 儘快（禮貌用語） | immediately 立刻
ex: Please send the revised proposal as soon as possible.
請儘快寄出修訂後的提案。
We need to address the customer complaint as soon as possible.
我們需要儘快處理顧客的投訴。
The manager asked for the report as soon as possible.
經理要求儘快拿到報告。

items.colloc: at this point in time 此時此刻 | at this point of the project 專案的這個階段
items.distinct: at the moment 此時 | currently 目前
ex: At this point, we cannot confirm the shipment date.
目前我們還無法確認出貨日期。
Everything seems to be working well at this point.
目前為止一切運作順利。
We have no further comments to make at this point.
我們目前沒有其他評論。

items.colloc: set up automatic payment 設定自動付款 | cancel automatic payment 取消自動付款
items.distinct: manual payment 手動付款 | online payment 線上付款
ex: You can set up automatic payment for your monthly bills.
你可以為每月帳單設定自動付款。
The service requires automatic payment via a credit card.
這項服務需要透過信用卡自動付款。
I prefer automatic payment to avoid late fees.
我比較喜歡自動付款以避免逾期費用。

items.colloc: be filled with excitement 充滿興奮 | be filled with documents 裝滿文件
items.distinct: full of 充滿（形容詞） | pack with 塞滿
ex: The conference room was filled with eager participants.
會議室裡擠滿了熱切的與會者。
His schedule is filled with back-to-back meetings today.
他今天的行程排滿了連續的會議。
The inbox was filled with inquiries from potential clients.
收件匣裡充滿了潛在客戶的詢問。

items.colloc: be open for business daily 每日營業 | officially be open for business 正式開業
items.distinct: open hours 營業時間 | closed for business 停止營業
ex: The new store will be open for business next Monday.
新店將於下週一正式開業。
We are happy to announce that we are now open for business.
我們很高興地宣布我們現在開始營業了。
The cafe will be open for business until nine tonight.
這家咖啡廳今晚將營業至九點。

items.colloc: belong to the company 屬於公司 | belong to the association 屬於協會
items.distinct: own 擁有 | member of 會員
ex: Does this equipment belong to the maintenance department?
這台設備是屬於維修部的嗎？
The laptop belongs to the marketing team leader.
這台筆記型電腦屬於行銷部組長。
This project does not belong to my current department.
這個專案不屬於我目前的部門。

items.colloc: bend over to pick up 彎腰撿起 | bend over backward 竭盡全力
items.distinct: lean over 傾身 | crouch 蹲下
ex: He had to bend over to retrieve the fallen files.
他必須彎腰去撿起掉落的文件。
Please do not bend over too quickly if you feel dizzy.
如果您感到頭暈，請不要動作太快地彎腰。
She bent over to examine the bottom shelf of the display.
她彎下腰去檢查展示架的最底層。

days.theme: 教材片語・進階 650–750 第 5 群

items.colloc: book business class 預訂商務艙 | upgrade to business class 升等至商務艙
items.distinct: economy class 經濟艙 | first class 頭等艙
ex: The executive prefers flying business class for long trips.
主管偏好在長途旅行時搭乘商務艙。
Our company policy covers business class for international flights.
公司政策支付國際航班的商務艙費用。
Business class seats offer extra legroom and better service.
商務艙座位提供額外的腿部空間與更好的服務。

items.pos: phr. 營業時間；辦公時間
items.colloc: during business hours 在營業時間內 | outside business hours 非辦公時間
items.distinct: office hours 辦公時間 | opening hours 開放時間
ex: Please call our office during regular business hours.
請在正常的辦公時間內致電我們辦公室。
We respond to all customer emails within business hours.
我們會在營業時間內回覆所有客戶的電子郵件。
The delivery will arrive during standard business hours.
快遞將會在標準營業時間內抵達。

items.colloc: book a conference room 預訂會議室 | reserve the conference room 保留會議室
items.distinct: meeting room 會議室（小型） | boardroom 董事會議室
ex: The marketing team is meeting in the main conference room.
行銷團隊正在主要會議室開會。
Please reserve the conference room for our afternoon presentation.
請為我們下午的簡報預訂會議室。
Is the large conference room available for the training session?
大型會議室有空檔供培訓課程使用嗎？

items.pos: phr. 與…衝突；與…時間重疊
items.colloc: scheduling conflict 時間衝突 | avoid conflict 避免衝突
items.distinct: disagree with 不同意 | clash with 衝突（更強烈）
ex: This appointment might conflict with your existing schedule.
這個預約可能會與您現有的行程衝突。
The new project timeline does not conflict with the deadline.
新的專案時程表與截止日期並不衝突。
My client meeting will conflict with the team building event.
我的客戶會議將與團隊建設活動時間重疊。

items.colloc: wash and dry dishes 洗滌並擦乾碗盤 | help dry dishes 幫忙擦碗盤
items.distinct: do the dishes 洗碗 | drain dishes 瀝乾碗盤
ex: We need to wash and dry dishes after the company lunch.
公司午餐後我們需要清洗並擦乾碗盤。
Could you please help dry dishes in the pantry?
你可以幫忙在茶水間擦乾碗盤嗎？
The staff will dry dishes before storing them in cabinets.
員工會在將碗盤收進櫥櫃前將其擦乾。

items.colloc: hired a fashion photographer 聘請時尚攝影師 | famous fashion photographer 知名時尚攝影師
items.distinct: press photographer 新聞攝影師 | portrait photographer 人像攝影師
ex: The magazine hired a famous fashion photographer for the shoot.
雜誌社聘請了一位知名時尚攝影師進行拍攝。
Working as a fashion photographer requires a creative eye.
擔任時尚攝影師需要具備創造性的眼光。
Our company interviewed a fashion photographer for the campaign.
我們公司為這項宣傳活動面試了一位時尚攝影師。

items.colloc: attend a film festival 參加電影節 | host a film festival 主辦電影節
items.distinct: movie premiere 電影首映 | awards ceremony 頒獎典禮
ex: Our department will sponsor the upcoming annual film festival.
我們部門將贊助即將到來的年度電影節。
Many international directors will attend this year's film festival.
許多國際導演將參加今年的電影節。
The film festival attracts thousands of cinema enthusiasts annually.
電影節每年吸引數千名電影愛好者。

items.colloc: get it for free 免費取得 | offer for free 免費提供
items.distinct: at no cost 免費（正式） | complimentary 免費贈送（禮貌）
ex: New customers can download the software trial for free.
新客戶可以免費下載軟體試用版。
The company provided extra training sessions for free.
公司免費提供了額外的培訓課程。
We are offering a consultation session for free this month.
我們本月提供免費的諮詢服務。

items.colloc: give me a call 給我打電話 | give a call later 之後再打
items.distinct: make a call 撥打電話 | return a call 回電
ex: Please give a call if you have any further questions.

I will give a call to the supplier to confirm delivery.
我會打電話給供應商確認送貨事宜。
Feel free to give a call before visiting our office.
前來我們辦公室之前，歡迎隨時打電話。

items.colloc: hand out flyers 分發傳單 | hand out documents 分發文件
items.distinct: distribute 分配（正式） | pass out 昏倒或發放
ex: The assistant will hand out the agendas before the meeting.
助理將在會議前分發議程表。

請將這些手冊分發給所有參與者。
It is standard procedure to hand out name tags at registration.
在報到處分發名牌是標準程序。

items.colloc: move in the direction of 朝…方向移動 | look in the direction of 看向…的方向
items.distinct: towards 朝向 | in the way of 以…方式

倉庫位於朝向機場的方向。

請往主大廳入口的方向走。

他指向新辦公大樓的方向。

ex: Our team is working on a new marketing strategy.
我們的團隊正致力於一項新的行銷策略。
He is currently working on his communication skills.
他目前正努力改善他的溝通技巧。
I have been working on this report all morning.
我整個早上都在處理這份報告。

items.colloc: in the early morning 在清晨 | early morning flight 清晨的班機
items.distinct: late night 深夜 | morning 早上
ex: We have an early morning meeting at eight.
我們八點有個清晨的會議。
The early morning air is very refreshing.
清晨的空氣非常清新。
Most of the staff arrive in the early morning.
大多數員工在清晨抵達辦公室。

days.theme: 教材片語・進階 650–750 第 8 群

items.colloc: meet the CEO 會見執行長 | report to the CEO 向執行長報告
items.distinct: president 總裁 | general manager 總經理
ex: The chief executive officer will host the meeting.
執行長將親自主持這次會議。
Our chief executive officer is visiting the new plant.
我們的執行長正在參訪新工廠。
The chief executive officer decided to expand the business.
執行長決定擴大業務規模。

items.colloc: clear the table top 清理桌面 | a polished table top 光滑的桌面
items.distinct: desktop 電腦桌面 | countertop 櫃檯桌面
ex: Please clear your documents from the table top.
請將文件從桌面上移開。
The table top is made of solid oak wood.
這張桌子的桌面是用實心橡木做的。
We placed the projector on the table top.
我們把投影機放在桌面上。

items.colloc: a sharp curve 急轉彎 | ahead of the curve 領先趨勢
items.distinct: line 直線 | angle 角度
ex: Sales figures showed a curve of steady growth.
銷售數據呈現出穩定成長的曲線。
The road has a sharp curve near the factory.
工廠附近的道路有一個大轉彎。
Our company stays ahead of the curve in technology.
我們公司在技術發展上保持領先。

items.colloc: a wide range of 廣泛的 | price range 價格區間
items.distinct: scope 領域範疇 | variety 各式各樣
ex: We offer a wide range of logistics services.
我們提供廣泛的物流服務。
The items fall within a reasonable price range.
這些商品的價格落在合理的區間內。
The product is available in a range of colors.
該產品有各種顏色可供選擇。

items.colloc: change a tire 更換輪胎 | flat tire 爆胎
items.distinct: wheel 車輪 | rubber 橡膠
ex: The delivery truck had a flat tire today.
送貨卡車今天發生了爆胎。
We need to check the tire pressure regularly.
我們需要定期檢查輪胎胎壓。
The mechanic replaced a tire on the company car.
維修技師更換了公務車的一個輪胎。

items.colloc: monthly pay 月薪 | pay raise 加薪
items.distinct: salary 固定薪水 | wage 時薪或週薪
ex: Your pay will be deposited on the fifth.
您的薪資將於五號存入帳戶。
The position offers competitive pay and benefits.
該職位提供具競爭力的薪資與福利。
Employees are demanding higher pay this year.
員工們今年要求提高薪資。

items.pos: phr. 透過清償未結債務
items.colloc: clear the debt 清償債務 | outstanding balance 未結餘額
items.distinct: pay off 償還 | settle 結算
ex: The firm improved by clearing its outstanding debt.
公司透過清償未結債務改善了財務狀況。
They succeeded by clearing its outstanding debt quickly.
他們藉由迅速清償未結債務而成功。
Focus on by clearing its outstanding debt first.
首要任務應是透過清償未結債務來穩定公司。

items.colloc: label a file folder 標記資料夾 | thick file folder 厚的資料夾
items.distinct: binder 活頁夾 | envelope 信封
ex: Please put these contracts in a file folder.
請將這些合約放入檔案夾中。
I cannot find the blue file folder anywhere.
我到處都找不到那個藍色的檔案夾。
Organize your papers in a separate file folder.
請將文件分類整理到不同的檔案夾。

items.colloc: heavy traffic 交通擁擠 | stuck in traffic 困在車陣中
items.distinct: traffic jam 交通堵塞 | congestion 壅塞
ex: I will be late because we have traffic.
因為遇到塞車我會遲到。
The highway tends to have traffic every morning.
這條高速公路每天早上往往都有車流。
We have traffic, so please start the meeting.
現在遇到塞車了，請先開始會議吧。

items.colloc: in fact, it is 事實上是 | in fact, no 事實上沒有
items.distinct: actually 實際上 | as a matter of fact 事實上
ex: In fact, the project was finished ahead of time.
事實上，該專案提前完成了。
The report is not ready; in fact, it is missing.
報告還沒準備好，事實上，它不見了。
In fact, we have already hired a new manager.
事實上，我們已經聘請了一位新經理。

items.pos: phr. 大體上；很大程度上
items.colloc: in large part 在很大程度上 | in large measure 在很大程度上
items.distinct: by and large 大體上 | in general 一般來說
ex: The success is in large part due to your help.
這次成功在很大程度上歸功於您的幫助。
This policy is in large measure a total failure.
這項政策在很大程度上是徹底的失敗。
In large part, the staff likes the new rules.
整體而言，員工們喜歡新的規則。

items.colloc: attend a job fair 參加就業博覽會 | host a job fair 舉辦徵才展
items.distinct: career fair 職涯博覽會 | recruitment event 招募活動
ex: Our company will attend a job fair tomorrow.
我們公司明天將參加就業博覽會。
Bring your resume to the annual job fair.
帶著你的履歷去參加年度就業博覽會。
Many students visited the job fair for opportunities.
許多學生參觀了就業博覽會尋找機會。

items.colloc: accept a job offer 接受工作邀約 | receive a job offer 收到錄取通知
items.distinct: job application 求職申請 | employment contract 聘僱合約
ex: I am happy to accept your job offer today.
我很高興今天接受您的工作錄取通知。
She received a job offer from a global firm.
她收到了一家跨國企業的工作錄取通知。
The job offer includes health insurance and bonuses.
這份工作邀約包含醫療保險與獎金。

items.colloc: keep adding more 持續增加更多 | keep adding items 持續加入項目
items.distinct: continue adding 持續增加 | keep increasing 保持成長
ex: We should keep add new features to the app.
我們應該持續為應用程式增加新功能。
The manager will keep add names to the list.
經理會不斷將名字加入名單中。
Please keep add relevant data to the report.
請持續將相關數據加入到報告中。

items.pos: phr. 管理層關注安全性
items.zh: 管理階層擔心安全問題
items.colloc: be concerned about 對...感到擔憂 | top management 高階管理層
items.distinct: management is worried 擔心 | management cares about 重視
ex: Management is concerned about security at the site.
管理階層對於該場地的安全性感到擔憂。
Clearly, management is concerned about security of data.
顯然地，管理階層很關心資料的安全性。
Because management is concerned about security, we updated locks.
由於管理階層擔心安全，我們更新了門鎖。

items.colloc: experience from a previous job 前職經驗 | leave a previous job 離職
items.distinct: former job 前任工作 | current job 目前工作
ex: My previous job involved a lot of traveling.
我的前一份工作需要頻繁出差。
List your previous job on the resume clearly.
請在履歷上清楚列出你的前一份工作。
I learned many sales skills in my previous job.
我在前一份工作中學到了許多銷售技巧。

items.colloc: import raw materials 進口原料 | cost of raw materials 原料成本
items.distinct: finished product 成品 | commodity 商品
ex: The factory has a shortage of raw material.
工廠目前有原料短缺的問題。
High prices of raw material affect our profits.
原物料的高價格影響了我們的利潤。
We need to source quality raw material today.
我們今天需要採購高品質的原材料。

items.colloc: meet a target 達成目標 | set a target 設定目標
items.distinct: fix target 設定目標 | achieve goal 達成目標
ex: The marketing team seals target for this quarter.
行銷團隊確立了本季度的目標。
He seals target to double the company sales.
他鎖定了將公司銷售額翻倍的目標。
Everyone works hard once the manager seals target.
一旦經理確立了目標，每個人都會努力工作。

items.colloc: send in an application 提交申請 | send in a resume 寄出履歷
items.distinct: submit 提交 | hand in 遞交
ex: Please send in your proposal by next Friday.
請在下週五前提交您的提案。
I decided to send in my application today.
我決定今天將我的申請表寄出。
Did you send in the tax documents yet?
你已經把稅務文件送交了嗎？

items.zh: 創業很花錢；創業代價高
items.colloc: start a business 創業 | high cost 高成本
items.distinct: expensive 昂貴的 | investment 投資
ex: Many people agree that starting a business is costly.
許多人都認同創業的成本很高。
Realize that starting a business is costly before acting.
在行動前要認知到創業是非常花錢的。
Because starting a business is costly, prepare funds.
由於創業費用高昂，請務必準備好資金。

days.theme: 教材片語・中高階 750–850 第 9 群

items.colloc: at the traffic light 在紅綠燈處 | obey traffic lights 遵守交通號誌
items.distinct: traffic signal 交通訊號 | pedestrian crossing 斑馬線
ex: Turn left at the next traffic light.
在下一個紅綠燈左轉。
The traffic light was broken during the storm.
暴風雨期間紅綠燈故障了。
We were stuck at a traffic light for minutes.
我們在紅綠燈路口卡了好幾分鐘。

items.colloc: leave a voice mail 留言 | check voice mail 檢查語音留言
items.distinct: text message 簡訊 | answering machine 電話答錄機
ex: Please leave a message on my voice mail.
請在我的語音信箱留言。
I checked my voice mail after the meeting.
我在會議後查看了語音留言。
Your call has been forwarded to voice mail.
您的電話已轉接至語音信箱。

items.colloc: need to wash the car 需要洗車 | help wash the car 幫忙洗車
items.distinct: car wash 洗車場 | wax the car 給車打蠟
ex: I plan to wash the car this weekend.
我打算這週末洗車。
He went to wash the car before the date.
他在約會前去把車洗乾淨。
Did you wash the car at the service station?
你在服務站洗車了嗎？

items.colloc: take on more work 承擔更多工作 | take on new staff 增聘員工
items.distinct: take over 接管 | take up 佔用
ex: We cannot take on any more projects now.
我們目前無法再承擔更多專案了。
The company decided to take on five new interns.
公司決定增聘五名實習生。
She is willing to take on extra responsibilities.
她願意承擔額外的責任。

items.colloc: come along with me 跟我一起去 | coming along well 進展順利
items.distinct: get along 相處融洽 | go along 贊同
ex: Would you like to come along to the lunch?
你要一起去吃午餐嗎？
The new marketing campaign is coming along nicely.
新的行銷活動進展很順利。
Please come along if you are interested.
如果你有興趣，請隨同前往。

items.colloc: turn out to be 結果竟然是 | turn out well 結果良好
items.distinct: turn off 關掉 | turn up 出現
ex: The report turned out to be inaccurate.
這份報告結果不準確。
It turned out that we were in the wrong room.
結果我們走錯房間了。
A large crowd turned out for the annual conference.
大批群眾出席了年度大會。

items.colloc: get back to you soon 盡快回覆你 | get back to work 回到工作崗位
items.distinct: call back 回電 | look back 回顧
ex: I will get back to you regarding the quote.
我會就報價事宜回覆你。
Let us get back to the main agenda item.
讓我們回到主要的議程項目上。
The manager will get back to the office shortly.
經理很快就會回到辦公室。

items.colloc: ask what does it mean 詢問意思 | clarify what does it mean 釐清意義
items.distinct: what is it for 有何用途 | why is it happening 為何發生
ex: I am confused, what does it mean for us?
我很困惑，這對我們意味著什麼？
Could you explain what does it mean in this context?
你能解釋在這個情境下是什麼意思嗎？
She asked what does it mean to be a leader.
她問成為一名領導者意味著什麼。

items.colloc: get in touch with the client 聯繫客戶 | try to get in touch 嘗試聯繫
items.distinct: keep in touch 保持聯繫 | lose touch 失聯
ex: Please get in touch with our HR department.
請與我們的人資部門取得聯繫。
I cannot get in touch with him by phone.
我無法透過電話聯繫上他。
We should get in touch with the supplier immediately.
我們應該立即聯繫供應商。

items.colloc: cut back on spending 削減支出 | cut back production 縮減產量
items.distinct: cut off 中斷 | cut down 砍倒
ex: The company needs to cut back on travel expenses.
公司需要削減差旅支出。
We had to cut back production due to low demand.
由於需求低迷，我們必須縮減生產。
They decided to cut back their working hours.
他們決定減少工作時數。

items.colloc: have a good view of the park 可看見公園 | a room with a good view 有風景的房間
items.distinct: in view 在視線內 | point of view 觀點
ex: The conference room has a good view of the harbor.
會議室有很好的港口景觀。
We want a hotel room that has a good view.
我們想要一間視野良好的飯店房間。
From the office, you have a good view of downtown.
從辦公室可以看到市中心的良好景致。

items.colloc: if you insist on it 如果你堅持這點 | accept if you insist 接受你的堅持
items.distinct: as you wish 隨你意 | as you please 請便
ex: If you insist, I will help you with the report.
如果你堅持的話，我會幫你處理這份報告。
I will take the extra work if you insist.
如果你堅持，我會承擔這項額外工作。
Well, if you insist, we can meet on Saturday.
好吧，如果你堅持的話，我們可以在週六見面。

items.colloc: attend a trade show 參加商展 | international trade show 國際貿易展
items.distinct: exhibition 展覽會 | conference 會議
ex: We are showcasing our new products at the trade show.
我們正在商展中展示新產品。
Many industry leaders will attend the upcoming trade show.
許多業界領袖將參加即將到來的貿易展。
I need to register for the international trade show.
我需要註冊參加國際貿易展。

items.colloc: be asked to do a task 被要求執行任務 | be asked to do overtime 被要求加班
items.distinct: be told to do 被告知要做 | be expected to do 被期望做
ex: I was asked to do a presentation tomorrow.
我被要求明天進行簡報。
He was asked to do some administrative work.
他被要求處理一些行政工作。
All staff were asked to do a safety briefing.
全體員工都被要求參加安全簡報。

items.colloc: bring in new ideas 引進新觀點 | bring in revenue 帶來收入
items.distinct: bring up 提出 | bring about 導致
ex: The new marketing manager will bring in fresh ideas.
新任行銷經理將引進創新的想法。
This project is expected to bring in more profit.
預期這個專案能帶來更多利潤。
They decided to bring in an expert for advice.
他們決定引進一位專家提供建議。

items.colloc: give a good price for the item 針對品項報優價 | negotiate a good price 議得好價
items.distinct: at a fair price 以合理價格 | offer a discount 提供折扣
ex: Can you give a good price for a bulk order?
大量訂購你能給個優惠價嗎？
The supplier promised to give a good price this time.
供應商承諾這次會給個好價格。
They always give a good price to loyal customers.
他們總是給老客戶優惠價格。

items.colloc: ask for a raise 要求加薪 | receive a raise 獲得加薪
items.distinct: increase salary 增加薪資 | bonus 獎金
ex: The manager decided to give her a raise.
經理決定給她加薪。
He is hoping to get a raise after the review.
他希望在績效考核後獲得加薪。
Does the company give a raise annually?
公司每年都會調薪嗎？

items.colloc: have an opportunity to speak 有機會發言 | miss the opportunity 錯過機會
items.distinct: have a chance to do 有機會做 | take an opportunity 把握機會
ex: I hope I have an opportunity to visit your office.
希望我有機會參訪貴公司。
She had an opportunity to work abroad for a year.
她曾有一年去國外工作的機會。
We will have an opportunity to discuss this further.
我們稍後會有機會進一步討論此事。

items.zh: 全國性的節日；國定假日
items.colloc: on a national holiday 在國定假日 | observe a national holiday 慶祝國定假日
items.distinct: public holiday 公眾假期 | festival 慶典
ex: The office will be closed for the national holiday.
公司將於國定假日期間暫停辦公。
Next Monday is a national holiday in this country.
下週一是該國的國定假日。
Staff receive extra pay during the national holiday.
員工在國定假日期間可獲得額外薪資。

items.colloc: keep someone on edge 讓人緊張 | feel on edge 感到焦慮
items.distinct: at the edge 在邊緣 | on the verge of 即將
ex: The deadline makes everyone feel a bit on edge.
截止日期讓每個人都感到有點緊張。
She was on edge while waiting for the results.
她在等待結果時感到忐忑不安。
Constant changes keep the whole team on edge.
不斷的變動讓整個團隊都神經緊繃。

days.theme: 教材片語・中高階 750–850 第 10 群

items.colloc: put out 拿出 | for display 供展示
items.distinct: showcase 櫥窗展示 | exhibit 展覽
ex: New products were put out for display in the lobby.
新產品已陳列在大廳供人參觀。
Please put out for display all the promotional items today.
請在今天把所有促銷品都陳列出來。
The team put out for display their latest design concepts.
團隊展示了他們最新的設計概念。

items.colloc: host a party 舉辦派對 | attend a party 參加派對
items.distinct: farewell party 歡送會 | reception 接待會
ex: We are organizing a retirement party for our director.
我們正在為部門主管籌備退休歡送會。
Everyone is invited to the retirement party this afternoon.
邀請各位參加今天下午的退休歡送會。
The retirement party will be held in the main conference room.
退休歡送會將在主會議室舉行。

items.colloc: break a record 打破紀錄 | current record 當前紀錄
items.distinct: make a record 錄音 | keep a record 紀錄存檔
ex: Our sales team managed to set a record this quarter.
我們的銷售團隊在本季創下了紀錄。
This new machine helped set a record for production speed.
這台新機器協助創下了生產速度的紀錄。
The company expects to set a record for annual profit.
公司預期將創下年度獲利紀錄。

items.colloc: take over the business 接管業務 | take over the project 接手專案
items.distinct: take on 承擔 | take up 佔用
ex: She will take over the marketing department starting next month.
她將從下個月起接管行銷部門。
Mr. Chen is going to take over as the project manager.
陳先生將接手擔任專案經理。
The multinational corporation decided to take over the local firm.
那家跨國公司決定接管當地的企業。

items.pos: phr. 逐步引導；詳細檢查
items.colloc: walk through the process 說明流程 | walk through the office 視察辦公室
items.distinct: go over 複習；審查 | look through 瀏覽
ex: Could you walk through the new system with me?
你可以帶我逐步了解這套新系統嗎？
The architect will walk through the construction site today.
建築師今天將會實地視察施工現場。
Let us walk through the contract clauses together tomorrow.
讓我們明天一起詳細審閱合約條款。

items.colloc: warm up the audience 炒熱氣氛 | warm up session 熱身階段
items.distinct: heat up 加熱 | cool down 冷卻
ex: The speaker tried to warm up the audience with a joke.
講者試圖用笑話來炒熱現場氣氛。
Please turn on the oven to warm up before baking.
烘烤前請先開啟烤箱進行預熱。
The team did some exercises to warm up before the meeting.

分析師將為下一季做出預測。
It is difficult to make forecast during market volatility.
在市場波動期間很難做出預測。
Our team needs to make forecast regarding annual revenue.
我們的團隊需要對年度營收做出預測。

items.colloc: make money quickly 快速賺錢 | make money from investments 從投資中獲利
items.distinct: earn a living 維持生計 | generate profit 產生利潤
ex: Their primary goal is to make money for shareholders.
他們的主要目標是為股東賺錢。
Many startups struggle to make money in the early stages.
許多新創公司在早期階段很難獲利。
Investing in technology can help you make money.
投資科技產業有助於你賺錢。

items.colloc: make the first move in negotiations 在談判中採取主動 | wait for someone to make the first move 等待對方採取主動
items.distinct: take the initiative 採取主動權 | strike first 先下手為強
ex: It is time for us to make the first move.
現在是我們採取主動的時候了。
He decided to make the first move to close the deal.
他決定採取主動來達成這筆交易。
Sometimes it pays to make the first move in business.
有時在商場上先發制人是有利的。

items.colloc: assess market value 評估市場價值 | exceed market value 超過市場價值
items.distinct: book value 帳面價值 | asset value 資產價值
ex: The company has a high market value right now.
這家公司目前有很高的市場價值。
We need to determine the market value of the property.
我們需要確定該房產的市場價值。
Changes in the economy affect the market value of stocks.
經濟變化影響股票的市場價值。

items.colloc: move forward with the plan 推進計畫 | move forward to the next stage 進入下一階段
items.distinct: go ahead 進行；同意 | carry on 繼續進行
ex: We are ready to move forward with the merger.
我們準備推進合併案。
The board decided to move forward despite the risks.
董事會決定儘管有風險仍繼續推進。
Please let us know how to move forward from here.
請讓我們知道接下來該如何進行。

items.colloc: much to one's surprise and delight 令某人又驚又喜 | much to everyone's surprise 令大家驚訝的是
items.distinct: to one's astonishment 令某人震驚的是 | unexpectedly 意外地
ex: Much to our surprise, the project was completed early.
令我們驚訝的是，該專案提前完成了。
Much to his surprise, he received a promotion today.
令他驚訝的是，他今天獲得了晉升。
The client canceled the order, much to our surprise.
令我們驚訝的是，客戶取消了訂單。

items.colloc: a newly established company 一家新成立的公司 | a newly established policy 一項新設立的政策
items.distinct: newly founded 新創立的 | newly created 新創造的
ex: The newly established department handles client complaints.
這個新成立的部門負責處理客戶投訴。
He works for a newly established firm in Taipei.
他在台北一家新成立的公司工作。
The newly established rules apply to all employees.
這些新設立的規則適用於所有員工。

items.zh: 禁止進入的；禁止觸碰的
items.colloc: be off limits to staff 對員工禁止進入 | declare an area off limits 宣布該區域為禁區
items.distinct: restricted 限制的 | prohibited 被禁止的
ex: The laboratory is off limits to unauthorized personnel.
實驗室禁止未經授權的人員進入。
Discussing salaries is off limits in this meeting.
在這次會議中禁止討論薪資問題。
The executive office is off limits during lunch time.
午餐時間行政辦公室禁止進入。

items.colloc: hold an official title 擁有正式職稱 | use an official title 使用正式頭銜
items.distinct: job description 工作描述 | position 職位
ex: What is your official title in this organization?
你在這個組織裡的正式職稱是什麼？
He prefers to use his official title on business cards.
他偏好在名片上使用他的正式職稱。
Her official title changed after the restructuring.
組織重組後她的正式職稱改變了。

items.colloc: put on the waiting list 列入候補名單 | remain on the waiting list 停留在候補名單
items.distinct: on standby 備用狀態 | at a queue 排隊中
ex: I am currently on the waiting list for the seminar.
我目前在研討會的候補名單上。
Many clients are on the waiting list for this service.
許多客戶都在這項服務的候補名單上。
Can you put my name on the waiting list?
你可以把我的名字加到候補名單上嗎？

items.colloc: book a one way ticket 預訂單程票 | purchase a one way ticket 購買單程票
items.distinct: round trip ticket 來回票 | return ticket 回程票
ex: He bought a one way ticket for his business trip.
他買了一張出差用的單程票。
The company prefers booking a one way ticket for flexibility.
公司為了靈活性傾向預訂單程票。
I only need a one way ticket to the conference.
我只需要一張去開會的單程票。

items.colloc: order a meal online 線上點餐 | order a meal for delivery 點餐外送
items.distinct: place an order 下訂單 | reserve a table 訂位
ex: We can order a meal before the meeting starts.
我們可以在會議開始前先點餐。
It is convenient to order a meal through the app.
透過應用程式點餐很方便。
She helped the guests order a meal at the hotel.
她協助客人在飯店點餐。

items.colloc: use the parking garage 使用停車場 | enter the parking garage 進入停車場
items.distinct: parking lot 停車場（平面） | street parking 路邊停車
ex: The office building has a spacious parking garage.
辦公大樓有一個寬敞的立體停車場。
Visitors can park in the underground parking garage.
訪客可以停在地下停車場。
She parked her car in the parking garage nearby.
她把車停在附近的立體停車場。

items.colloc: pass by the office 路過辦公室 | pass by the building 經過建築物
items.distinct: go past 經過 | drop by 順道拜訪
ex: I will pass by your desk later this afternoon.
今天下午稍晚我會經過你的座位。
Did you pass by the construction site today?
你今天有經過工地嗎？
The courier will pass by to pick up the parcel.
快遞員會順道過來領取包裹。

items.colloc: cater to people of all ages 滿足所有年齡層的人 | attract people of all ages 吸引各年齡層的人
items.distinct: all age groups 所有年齡組 | various age groups 各種年齡組
ex: The event is suitable for people of all ages.
這個活動適合所有年齡層的人參與。
Our products are designed for people of all ages.
我們的產品專為所有年齡層的人設計。
This park attracts people of all ages every weekend.
這個公園每個週末都吸引各年齡層的人。

items.colloc: post a notice on the board 在佈告欄貼公告 | post a notice on the wall 在牆上貼公告
items.distinct: put up a sign 豎立標誌 | announce an update 發布更新
ex: The manager will post a notice on the bulletin board.
經理將在佈告欄張貼公告。
Please post a notice on the door regarding the closure.
請在門上張貼關於關閉的公告。
They decided to post a notice on the company website.
他們決定在公司網站上張貼公告。

items.colloc: provided that the terms are met 只要條件符合 | provided that we agree 假設我們同意
items.distinct: on condition that 在...條件下 | as long as 只要
ex: We can proceed provided that you sign the contract.
只要你簽署合約，我們就可以繼續進行。
The deal is valid provided that the funds are cleared.
只要資金到位，這筆交易即有效。
You may take leave provided that your work is finished.
只要你的工作完成了，你就可以請假。

items.colloc: pull down the old building 拆除舊建築 | pull down the shades 拉下遮陽簾
items.distinct: tear down 拆除 | take down 拆卸
ex: The city plans to pull down the old warehouse.
市政府計畫拆除這座舊倉庫。
They decided to pull down the posters before the event.
他們決定在活動前把海報取下。
Workers will pull down the structure next month.
工人下個月將拆除這個建築結構。

items.colloc: pull into the station 駛入車站 | pull into the driveway 駛入車道
items.distinct: drive into 開進 | enter 進入
ex: The train will pull into the station shortly.
火車即將駛入車站。
He slowly pulled into the parking space.
他緩慢地將車開入停車位。
We watched the bus pull into the depot.
我們看著巴士駛入車廠。

items.colloc: put away the files 收拾檔案 | put away documents 整理文件
items.distinct: pack up 打包 | store away 儲藏
ex: Please put away your reports after the meeting.
會議結束後請把你的報告收拾好。
She took a moment to put away the office supplies.
她花了一點時間收拾辦公用品。
Make sure to put away all sensitive documents securely.
務必將所有機密文件妥善收好。

days.theme: 教材片語・中高階 750–850 第 16 群

items.colloc: put down in writing 書面記錄 | put down a deposit 支付訂金
items.distinct: write down 寫下（強調資訊） | note down 隨手記下
ex: Please put down your contact details on this form.
請在表格上寫下您的聯絡資訊。
We decided to put down a deposit for the equipment.
我們決定為這項設備支付訂金。
Never put down your colleagues during a team meeting.
在團隊會議中絕不要貶低你的同事。

items.colloc: put forward a proposal 提出提案 | put forward a suggestion 提出建議
items.distinct: bring up 提及（話題） | propose 提議（較正式）
ex: Several managers put forward new ideas for the project.
幾位經理為這項計畫提出了新構想。
The committee will put forward a candidate for the role.
委員會將推薦一名候選人擔任該職位。
She put forward a compelling argument during the negotiation.
她在談判中提出了具說服力的觀點。

items.colloc: put in an offer on a house 對房屋出價 | accept an offer 接受報價
items.distinct: make a bid 競標 | submit a quote 提交報價單
ex: We decided to put in an offer on the office building.
我們決定對該辦公大樓出價。
They put in an offer shortly after the property listing.
他們在房產刊登後不久就提出了報價。
Are you planning to put in an offer for this contract?
你打算為這份合約投標嗎？

items.colloc: put in for a transfer 申請調職 | put in for a raise 申請加薪
items.distinct: apply for 申請（通用） | request 要求
ex: I have decided to put in for a transfer to Tokyo.
我已經決定申請調職到東京。
He put in for a week of vacation starting next Monday.
他申請了從下週一開始的一週假期。
She put in for a promotion after completing the certification.
她在完成認證後申請了升遷。

items.colloc: put new policies into effect 實施新政策 | come into effect 開始生效
items.distinct: carry out 執行（任務） | implement 實行（計畫）
ex: The company will put new safety rules into effect tomorrow.
公司將於明天實施新的安全規定。
These changes were put into effect to improve efficiency.
這些改變是為了提升效率而實施的。
We are ready to put our strategy into effect immediately.
我們準備好立即實施我們的策略。

items.colloc: put up with the noise 忍受噪音 | put up with the delay 忍受延遲
items.distinct: tolerate 容忍（正式） | stand 忍受（口語）
ex: We cannot put up with such poor service anymore.
我們無法再忍受如此糟糕的服務了。
She has to put up with long commutes every single day.
她每天都必須忍受長途通勤。
Employees should not have to put up with a toxic environment.
員工不該忍受惡劣的工作環境。

items.pos: phr. 無論天氣好壞；風雨無阻
items.colloc: work rain or shine 風雨無阻地工作 | happen rain or shine 無論如何都會發生
items.distinct: no matter what 不管怎樣 | come what may 無論發生什麼
ex: The outdoor event will continue rain or shine.
戶外活動將會風雨無阻地舉行。
Our mail carrier delivers packages rain or shine.
我們的郵差風雨無阻地派送包裹。
We will complete this project on time, rain or shine.
無論如何，我們都會如期完成專案。

items.colloc: reach a firm conclusion 達成明確結論 | fail to reach a conclusion 無法達成結論
items.distinct: come to a decision 做出決定 | draw a conclusion 推論出結果
ex: The board of directors failed to reach a conclusion today.
董事會今天未能達成結論。
We carefully reviewed the data to reach a conclusion.
我們仔細審查數據以得出結論。
It takes time to reach a conclusion on such complex issues.
針對如此複雜的問題，需要時間才能得出結論。

items.zh: 找到解決方法；解決問題
items.colloc: reach the solution quickly 快速找到方法 | reach the optimal solution 達到最佳解
items.distinct: find a way 找到方法 | solve the problem 解決問題
ex: The team worked together to reach the solution effectively.
團隊通力合作以有效地找到解決方案。
We finally reached the solution after several hours of discussion.
經過數小時討論，我們終於找到解決方法。
It is difficult to reach the solution without more information.
沒有更多資訊很難找到解決方案。

items.colloc: react to criticism 對批評做出反應 | react to the news 對消息產生反應
items.distinct: respond to 回應（較積極） | reply to 回覆（文字或口頭）
ex: How did the investors react to the quarterly report?
投資人對季度報告有什麼反應？
The market is starting to react to the new regulations.
市場開始對新法規做出反應。
Management needs to react to employee feedback promptly.
管理層需要及時回應員工的反饋。

items.zh: 不動產銷售；房地產交易
items.colloc: manage a real estate sale 管理房地產銷售 | increase real estate sales 增加銷售額
items.distinct: property transaction 房產交易 | housing market 房地產市場
ex: The real estate sale was finalized late yesterday afternoon.
不動產銷售在昨天下午晚些時候完成。
Our firm specializes in commercial real estate sales.
我們公司專注於商業不動產銷售。
Interest rates have impacted current real estate sales significantly.
利率已顯著影響了當前的房地產銷售。

items.zh: 正常工作時間；辦公時間
items.colloc: during regular working hours 在辦公時間內 | outside regular working hours 在非工作時間
items.distinct: office hours 辦公時間 | shift work 輪班工作
ex: Please call our service center during regular working hours.
請在正常辦公時間內撥打我們的服務中心。
Our technicians are available outside of regular working hours.
我們的技術人員在非工作時間也可提供服務。
She prefers to complete tasks during regular working hours.
她傾向於在正常工作時間內完成任務。

items.colloc: rent out an apartment 出租公寓 | rent out office space 出租辦公空間
items.distinct: lease 出租（長期） | rent from 向他人租入
ex: They plan to rent out the vacant office on the second floor.
他們計畫將二樓的空辦公室出租。
Is it profitable to rent out your property as a studio?
將你的房產作為工作室出租有利可圖嗎？
The owner decided to rent out the building to a startup.
屋主決定將該建築出租給一家新創公司。

items.colloc: call a repair person 請維修人員 | wait for a repair person 等候維修人員
items.distinct: technician 技術人員 | handyman 雜務工
ex: I have scheduled a repair person to fix the printer.
我已預約維修人員來修理印表機。
The repair person arrived earlier than expected this morning.
維修人員今天早上比預期提早到達。
Ask the repair person to provide a written estimate.
請維修人員提供一份書面估價單。

items.colloc: report a problem to IT 回報問題給資訊部 | report a technical problem 回報技術問題
items.distinct: file a complaint 提出投訴 | inform of an issue 通知某問題
ex: Please report any problem you encounter with the software.
請回報您在使用該軟體時遇到的任何問題。
He went to the manager to report a problem with the line.
他向經理報告生產線出現的問題。
Customers can report a problem via our official website.
客戶可以透過我們的官方網站回報問題。

items.colloc: enter a restricted area 進入管制區 | access to restricted areas 進入管制區的權限
items.distinct: private property 私人領地 | prohibited zone 禁止區域
ex: Only authorized personnel may enter this restricted area.
只有授權人員可以進入此管制區。
The warehouse is a restricted area for safety reasons.
基於安全理由，倉庫屬於限制區域。
Please stay away from the restricted area near the construction site.
請遠離工地附近的管制區。

items.colloc: undergo road construction 進行道路施工 | delay due to road construction 因修路而延遲
items.distinct: road work 道路工程（通用） | infrastructure project 基礎建設專案
ex: Road construction will begin on the main highway tomorrow.
主要公路的道路施工明天將會開始。
Expect traffic delays caused by ongoing road construction.
由於進行中的道路施工，請預期交通會有所延誤。
We had to change our route because of road construction.
我們因為道路施工必須改變路線。

items.colloc: follow a road sign 遵守路標 | ignore a road sign 忽略路標
items.distinct: traffic light 紅綠燈 | street sign 街道名稱牌
ex: The road sign clearly indicated the speed limit ahead.
路標清楚地標示了前方的限速。
You should pay attention to every road sign while driving.
駕駛時應注意每一個道路標誌。
The obscured road sign made it difficult to find the turn.
被遮住的路標讓人很難找到轉彎處。

items.colloc: heavy road work 大規模道路工程 | notify of road work 通知道路工程
items.distinct: construction site 工地 | street maintenance 街道維護
ex: There is significant road work happening in the city center.
市中心正在進行重大的道路工程。
The city council announced road work for the next month.
市議會宣布了下個月的道路工程。
Plan your commute carefully during this period of road work.
在這段道路工程期間，請妥善規劃你的通勤。

items.colloc: run a meeting efficiently 有效主持會議 | run a weekly meeting 每週主持會議
items.distinct: chair a meeting 主席主持會議 | lead a discussion 引導討論
ex: She knows how to run a meeting and keep it brief.
她知道如何主持會議並保持簡短。
The CEO will run a meeting regarding the new merger.
執行長將主持一場關於新合併案的會議。
It is challenging to run a meeting with so many participants.
主持一場有這麼多參與者的會議很有挑戰性。

days.theme: 教材片語・中高階 750–850 第 17 群

items.colloc: experienced sales person 資深業務員 | contact a sales person 聯繫業務員
items.distinct: sales representative 銷售代表 | clerk 店員（門市）
ex: The sales person provided a detailed product demonstration.
業務員提供了詳細的產品演示。
Please consult a sales person for current discounts.
請詢問銷售人員目前的折扣優惠。
Our top sales person exceeded the annual quota.
我們最優秀的業務員超過了年度配額。

items.colloc: build a scale model 製作比例模型 | show a scale model 展示比例模型
items.distinct: prototype 原型機 | mock-up 實體模型（通常為等比例）
ex: The architect presented a scale model of the building.
建築師展示了該建築的比例模型。
We used a scale model to test the wind resistance.
我們使用比例模型來測試抗風性。
The company displayed a scale model in the lobby.
公司在大廳展示了一個比例模型。

items.pos: adj. 二手的；間接得到的
items.colloc: second hand furniture 二手家具 | second hand information 間接消息
items.distinct: used 使用過的 | recycled 回收再利用的
ex: He bought some second hand office equipment to save money.
他買了一些二手辦公設備以節省開支。
This information is only second hand from my manager.
這項消息只是我從經理那邊聽來的間接資訊。
Many startups prefer purchasing second hand machinery.
許多新創公司傾向購買二手機械設備。

items.colloc: pay a security deposit 支付押金 | refund a security deposit 退還押金
items.distinct: down payment 頭期款 | earnest money 定金
ex: A security deposit is required for the office rental.
承租辦公室需要支付一筆押金。
The landlord returned the security deposit after the inspection.
房東在驗屋後退還了押金。
Please ensure the security deposit is paid before moving.
請確保在搬入前已支付保證金。

items.colloc: take a short cut 走捷徑 | find a short cut 尋找捷徑
items.distinct: alternative route 替代路線 | direct path 直達路徑
ex: There is no short cut to achieving professional success.
在職業生涯取得成功沒有捷徑。
The delivery driver took a short cut through the alley.
快遞司機抄捷徑穿過巷子。
Management wanted a short cut to improve efficiency.
管理層想尋找提升效率的捷徑。

items.colloc: show up late 遲到 | show up on time 準時出現
items.distinct: turn up 到達；出現 | attend 出席
ex: Most employees managed to show up for the meeting.
大部分員工都設法出席了會議。
