items.pos: phr. 採取行動；搬家；啟程
items.colloc: make a move to start 開始行動 | make a move before others 在他人之前採取行動
items.distinct: take action 採取行動 | set off 出發
ex: It is time for us to make a move on this proposal.
我們現在是時候對這項提案採取行動了。
The company will make a move into the international market.
公司將採取行動進入國際市場。
We should make a move now to reach the venue on time.
我們現在就該出發，才能準時抵達會場。

items.colloc: make a note of the date 記下日期 | make a note of instructions 記下說明
items.distinct: take down 寫下 | jot down 草草記下
ex: Please make a note of the revised meeting time.
請記下修改後的會議時間。
I will make a note of your suggestions for future reference.
我會記下你的建議以供日後參考。
Make a note of any questions you have during the presentation.
請在簡報期間記下你有任何疑問之處。

items.colloc: make a recording of the lecture 錄下演講 | allow to make a recording 允許錄音
items.distinct: record a video 錄影 | take a transcript 做逐字稿
ex: The technician will make a recording of the board meeting.
技術人員將會為董事會會議進行錄音。
We decided to make a recording for those who missed the session.
我們決定為錯過會議的人製作一份錄音檔。
Are you allowed to make a recording during the interview?
面試期間允許進行錄音嗎？

items.colloc: make a selection from the menu 從菜單中選擇 | assist you to make a selection 協助你挑選
items.distinct: choose 選擇 | select 挑選
ex: Take your time to make a selection from our product catalog.
請慢慢從我們的產品目錄中挑選。
Customers can make a selection online before visiting the store.
顧客可以在前往門市前先在網路上進行選擇。
It is difficult to make a selection among these great candidates.
要在這些優秀候選人中做出選擇很困難。

items.colloc: make a stop at the station 在車站停靠 | make a stop for lunch 中途停下來吃午餐
items.distinct: stop over 中途過夜 | pause 暫停
ex: The tour bus will make a stop at the local museum.
觀光巴士將會在當地博物館中途停留。
We need to make a stop at the post office first.
我們需要先在郵局停一下。
The train will make a stop in every major city.
火車將會在每個大城市停靠。

items.colloc: make a transfer to another account 轉帳到另一個帳戶 | make a transfer at the airport 在機場轉機
items.distinct: wire money 匯款 | switch 轉換
ex: You can make a transfer using our mobile banking application.
您可以使用我們的行動銀行應用程式進行轉帳。
Passengers need to make a transfer to reach their final destination.
乘客需要轉乘才能抵達最終目的地。
I will make a transfer to cover the invoice amount.
我會進行轉帳以支付帳單金額。

items.colloc: make an exception for someone 為某人破例 | refuse to make an exception 拒絕破例
items.distinct: give an exemption 豁免 | waive a rule 放棄規則
ex: The manager agreed to make an exception for this urgent case.
經理同意為這起緊急案件破例。
We cannot make an exception to our company policy.
我們不能對公司政策破例。
She decided to make an exception because of his excellent record.
因為他表現優異，她決定破例一次。

items.colloc: make an impression on someone 給某人留下印象 | make a good impression 留下好印象
items.distinct: leave a mark 留下痕跡 | influence someone 影響某人
ex: The candidate made a positive impression during the interview.
這位候選人在面試時留下了良好的印象。
Dressing professionally helps you make an impression in meetings.
穿著專業有助於在會議中留下好印象。
He really wants to make an impression on the new director.
他非常希望能給新任總監留下深刻印象。

items.pos: phr. 沒有例外；一律相同
items.colloc: make no exception for anyone 對任何人都不例外 | allow for making no exception 規定沒有例外
items.distinct: without exception 無一例外 | apply to all 適用於所有人
ex: All employees must attend the training, making no exception.
所有員工都必須參加培訓，沒有例外。
The security rules apply to everyone and we make no exception.
安全規則適用於每個人，我們不會有任何例外。
We make no exception to the deadline for submitting reports.
我們對於提交報告的截止日期絕不破例。

days.theme: 教材片語・中高階 750–850 第 27 群

items.colloc: make urgent repairs 緊急維修 | make minor repairs 小修
items.distinct: conduct repairs 執行維修 | perform maintenance 執行保養
ex: Technicians will make repairs to the faulty equipment tomorrow.
技術人員明天將對故障設備進行維修。
The landlord refused to make repairs on the leaking roof.
房東拒絕維修漏水的屋頂。
It is necessary to make repairs before we open the store.
我們開店前必須進行維修。

items.colloc: properly make the bed 把床鋪好 | forget to make the bed 忘記鋪床
items.distinct: clean the room 打掃房間 | tidy up the room 整理房間
ex: Hotel staff are required to make the bed daily.
飯店員工必須每天鋪床。
I usually make the bed as soon as I wake up.
我通常起床後馬上就鋪床。
The housekeeping service will make the bed during your stay.
住宿期間客房服務會為您鋪床。

items.colloc: make up for lost time 補回時間 | make up for the loss 彌補損失
items.distinct: compensate for 賠償 | make amends for 賠罪
ex: He worked overtime to make up for his absence last week.
他加班以彌補上週的缺席。
The company offered a discount to make up for the delay.
公司提供折扣以彌補延誤。
Nothing can make up for the loss of his reputation.
沒有什麼能彌補他失去的名譽。

items.colloc: move ahead with the plan 推進計畫 | move ahead with the project 繼續專案
items.distinct: proceed with 繼續進行 | carry on with 繼續做
ex: Management decided to move ahead with the expansion plan.
管理層決定繼續推進擴張計畫。
We are ready to move ahead with the new software installation.
我們準備開始安裝新軟體。
The board will move ahead with the merger next month.
董事會下個月將推進合併事宜。

items.pos: phr. 往旁邊挪一個位子
items.colloc: kindly move over one seat 請往旁邊挪一個位子 | move over one seat please 請往旁邊移動一個座位
items.distinct: change seats 換位子 | switch seats 交換位子
ex: Could you please move over one seat to the left?
您可以往左邊挪一個位子嗎？
She asked the passenger to move over one seat.
她請那位乘客往旁邊挪一個位子。
Please move over one seat so my friend can sit down.
請往旁邊挪一個位子讓我朋友坐下。

items.colloc: constant need monitoring 持續需要監控 | urgent need monitoring 緊急需要監控
items.distinct: require observation 需要觀察 | demand supervision 需要督導
ex: The performance of the new server will need monitoring.
新伺服器的效能需要進行監控。
Patient vital signs will need monitoring during the procedure.
手術期間病人的生命徵象需要監控。
This investment strategy will need monitoring every quarter.
這項投資策略每季都需要監控。

items.colloc: report net income 報告淨利 | exceed net income 超過淨利
items.distinct: gross income 毛利 | total revenue 總營收
ex: The company reported a record high net income this year.
公司今年報告了創紀錄的淨利。
Our net income decreased due to rising production costs.
由於生產成本上升，我們的淨利減少了。
Investors focus on the annual net income of the corporation.
投資者關注該公司的年度淨利。

items.colloc: work the night shift 上夜班 | night shift allowance 夜班津貼
items.distinct: day shift 日班 | graveyard shift 大夜班
ex: He has been working the night shift for three years.
他已經上夜班三年了。
Employees on the night shift receive a higher hourly wage.
上夜班的員工領取較高的時薪。
She prefers the night shift because it is quieter.
她比較喜歡夜班，因為環境比較安靜。

items.colloc: no later than Friday 不晚於週五 | no later than noon 不晚於中午
items.distinct: by 在…之前 | before 在…之前
ex: Please submit your expense report no later than Friday.
請在週五之前提交您的費用報告。
All applications must be received no later than closing time.
所有申請必須在截止時間前收到。
The shipment will arrive no later than next Wednesday.
貨物將不晚於下週三送達。

items.colloc: reduce noise and air pollution 減少噪音與空氣污染 | cause noise and air pollution 造成噪音與空氣污染
items.distinct: environmental damage 環境破壞 | industrial waste 工業廢棄物
ex: The factory faces complaints about noise and air pollution.
這家工廠面臨關於噪音與空氣污染的投訴。
City officials are working to lower noise and air pollution.
市政府官員正致力於降低噪音與空氣污染。
Strict regulations help control noise and air pollution levels.
嚴格的規定有助於控制噪音與空氣污染水平。

items.colloc: order office supplies 訂購辦公用品 | stock of office supplies 辦公用品庫存
items.distinct: stationery 文具 | office equipment 辦公設備
ex: We need to restock our office supplies every month.
我們每個月都需要補充辦公用品。
Please include the cost of office supplies in the budget.
請將辦公用品的費用納入預算中。
The purchasing department handles all office supplies orders.
採購部門負責所有的辦公用品訂單。

items.colloc: be on a business trip 去出差 | send on a business trip 派去出差
items.distinct: on vacation 度假中 | on a mission 出任務
ex: The manager is currently on a business trip in Japan.
經理目前正在日本出差。
I will be on a business trip for the entire week.
我整個星期都會在出差。
You can email me while I am on a business trip.
我出差時可以透過電子郵件聯絡我。

items.colloc: exercise on an empty stomach 空腹運動 | take medicine on an empty stomach 空腹吃藥
items.distinct: on a full stomach 吃飽後 | on a light stomach 肚子不太餓
ex: It is not advisable to exercise on an empty stomach.
不建議在空腹的情況下運動。
He felt dizzy because he worked on an empty stomach.
因為空腹工作，他感到頭暈。
The doctor instructed me to take pills on an empty stomach.
醫生指示我空腹服用藥丸。

items.colloc: travel on business 因公出差 | be away on business 因公外出
items.distinct: for pleasure 為了遊玩 | for personal reasons 基於個人原因
ex: He is visiting Seoul on business next month.
他下個月因公去首爾拜訪。
Are you in this city on business or for vacation?
您在這座城市是出差還是度假？
Many executives travel on business throughout the year.
許多主管整年都在因公奔波。

items.colloc: pay on delivery 貨到付款 | check on delivery 交貨時檢查
items.distinct: upon arrival 到達時 | at the time of purchase 購買時
ex: You must make the payment on delivery of the goods.
貨到時您必須進行付款。
Please inspect the package carefully on delivery.
請在交貨時仔細檢查包裹。
The courier will collect the fee on delivery.
快遞員將在交貨時收取費用。

items.colloc: be on duty 值班中 | while on duty 值班期間
items.distinct: off duty 下班 | on call 待命
ex: Security guards are on duty throughout the night.
保全人員整晚都在值班。
He is not allowed to use his phone while on duty.
他在值班期間不准使用手機。
The doctor on duty will assist you shortly.
值班醫生稍後會協助您。

items.colloc: be on loan 借出中 | get items on loan 借用物品
items.distinct: for sale 待售 | in stock 現貨
ex: That painting is currently on loan to the city museum.
那幅畫目前正出借給市立博物館。
The equipment is on loan from another department.
這項設備是從其他部門借來的。
Books on loan must be returned by the due date.
借出的書籍必須在期限前歸還。

items.colloc: do something on purpose 故意做某事 | not do it on purpose 不是故意的
items.distinct: by accident 意外地 | by mistake 錯誤地
ex: I did not break your mug on purpose.
我不是故意打破你的馬克杯。
He was late on purpose to avoid the meeting.
他是故意遲到的，為了避開會議。
She did it on purpose to get my attention.
她是故意這樣做來吸引我的注意。

items.colloc: finish on schedule 按時完成 | keep on schedule 保持進度
items.distinct: ahead of schedule 超前進度 | behind schedule 落後進度
ex: The construction project is expected to finish on schedule.
這項建築工程預計會按時完成。
We are working hard to keep the project on schedule.
我們正努力讓專案保持在進度上。
The train arrived exactly on schedule this morning.
火車今天早上準時抵達。

items.colloc: be out of order 故障 | remain out of order 處於故障狀態
items.distinct: in working order 運作正常 | out of stock 缺貨
ex: The elevator is out of order, please use the stairs.
電梯故障了，請走樓梯。
This vending machine has been out of order for weeks.
這台自動販賣機已經故障好幾週了。
All the printers are out of order today.
今天所有的印表機都故障了。

days.theme: 教材片語・中高階 750–850 第 28 群

items.colloc: paint an outdoor wall 粉刷外牆 | repair the outdoor wall 修復外牆
items.distinct: exterior wall 外牆 | facade 建築正面
ex: The outdoor wall requires a fresh coat of paint.
這面室外牆需要重新粉刷。
Maintenance crews are fixing the damaged outdoor wall.
維修人員正在修復受損的室外牆。
We installed security cameras on the outdoor wall.
我們在室外牆上安裝了監視攝影機。

items.colloc: over price the product 把產品定價過高 | avoid over pricing 避免定價過高
items.distinct: overcharge 索價過高 | inflate price 哄抬價格
ex: Do not over price the items in our new catalog.
別把我們新目錄中的商品定價過高。
They tend to over price their services during the peak season.
他們傾向在旺季將服務定價過高。
If you over price the inventory, sales will likely decline.
如果你將庫存定價過高，銷售量可能會下降。

items.colloc: a roll of packing tape 一卷封箱膠帶 | use packing tape 使用包裝膠帶
items.distinct: masking tape 遮蔽膠帶 | duct tape 強力膠帶
ex: Please seal the cardboard boxes with packing tape.
請用包裝膠帶把紙箱封好。
We ran out of packing tape in the shipping department.
運務部門的包裝膠帶用完了。
Secure the package firmly using high-quality packing tape.
使用高品質的包裝膠帶將包裹牢固封好。

items.colloc: pair up with a partner 與夥伴搭檔 | pair up with a colleague 與同事配對
items.distinct: team up with 與…組隊 | partner with 與…合作
ex: You should pair up with a colleague for this task.
你應該找位同事搭檔完成這項任務。
Employees were asked to pair up with someone from another department.
員工被要求與其他部門的人配對。
I will pair up with him to finish the final report.
我會和他搭檔來完成最後的報告。

items.pos: phr. 忽視；略過；不予考慮
items.colloc: pass over a candidate 略過候選人 | pass over an opportunity 錯過機會
items.distinct: overlook 忽略 | bypass 越過
ex: He was passed over for the promotion last year.
他去年升遷時被跳過了。
The committee decided to pass over that proposal for now.
委員會決定暫時擱置那個提案。
Management should not pass over such a talented employee.
管理層不該忽視如此有才華的員工。

items.colloc: pass up a chance 錯失機會 | pass up an offer 放棄提議
items.distinct: give up 放棄 | miss out 錯失
ex: It is an opportunity you should not pass up.
這是一個你不該錯過的好機會。
She decided to pass up the job offer in London.
她決定放棄倫敦那份工作邀約。
We cannot afford to pass up such a lucrative contract.
我們承擔不起錯失這份有利可圖的合約。

items.pos: phr. 得到回報；償清（債務）
items.colloc: pay off the debt 還清債務 | the effort paid off 努力得到回報
items.distinct: pay back 償還 | pay up 付清
ex: Their hard work finally paid off with a big contract.
他們的努力最終獲得了一份大合約作為回報。
We need to pay off our company loans within two years.
我們需要在兩年內還清公司貸款。
The new marketing strategy is expected to pay off soon.
新的行銷策略預計很快就會見效。

items.colloc: request a pay raise 要求加薪 | receive a pay raise 獲得加薪
items.distinct: salary increase 加薪 | promotion 升遷
ex: He is planning to ask his boss for a pay raise.
他正計畫向老闆提出加薪要求。
The employees are negotiating for a significant pay raise.
員工們正在協商爭取顯著的加薪。
Performance reviews are often linked to a potential pay raise.
績效考核通常與潛在的加薪掛鉤。

items.colloc: declare personal effects 申報個人物品 | store personal effects 存放個人物品
items.distinct: belongings 財產 | property 資產
ex: Passengers must declare any personal effects at customs.
旅客必須在海關申報所有個人物品。
Please remove all personal effects from your desk before moving.
搬遷前請清空辦公桌上的所有個人物品。
The insurance policy covers loss of personal effects during travel.
保險單涵蓋旅行期間個人物品的遺失。

items.zh: 個人管理；人力資源管理
items.colloc: improve personal management 提升個人管理 | effective personal management 有效的個人管理
items.distinct: time management 時間管理 | personnel management 人事管理
ex: Effective personal management is crucial for career success.
有效的個人管理對職涯成功至關重要。
She took a seminar on personal management and organization.
她參加了一場關於個人管理與組織的研討會。
Good personal management helps reduce stress in the workplace.
良好的個人管理有助於減少職場壓力。

items.colloc: pick up the phone promptly 迅速接電話 | fail to pick up the phone 未能接聽
items.distinct: answer the phone 回應電話 | dial a number 撥號
ex: No one picked up the phone when I called the office.
我打電話到辦公室時沒人接聽。
You should pick up the phone if it rings during the meeting.
如果會議中電話響了，你應該接聽。
She was too busy to pick up the phone yesterday afternoon.
她昨天下午忙到無法接電話。

items.colloc: state the place of origin 說明原產地 | verify the place of origin 核實產地
items.distinct: source 來源 | location 地點
ex: The label must clearly indicate the product's place of origin.
標籤必須清楚標示產品的原產地。
We need to confirm the place of origin for these raw materials.
我們需要確認這些原材料的原產地。
Customs officials checked the goods and their place of origin.
海關官員檢查了貨物及其原產地。

items.colloc: plenty of time 充裕的時間 | plenty of resources 大量的資源
items.distinct: a lot of 許多的 | abundant 豐富的
ex: We have plenty of time to finish the project proposal.
我們有充裕的時間完成專案企劃書。
There is plenty of space in the new office building.
新的辦公大樓有充足的空間。
The company has plenty of resources to invest in research.
這家公司有大量的資源可以投資研發。

items.colloc: reach a potential customer 接觸潛在客戶 | attract potential customers 吸引潛在客戶
items.distinct: existing customer 現有客戶 | target audience 目標受眾
ex: Our sales team is reaching out to every potential customer.
我們的業務團隊正在接觸每一位潛在客戶。
We aim to convert potential customers into long-term clients.
我們的目標是將潛在客戶轉化為長期合作夥伴。
Providing free samples is a great way to attract potential customers.
提供免費樣品是吸引潛在客戶的好方法。

items.colloc: gain practical experience 獲得實務經驗 | relevant practical experience 相關實務經驗
items.distinct: theoretical knowledge 理論知識 | hands-on experience 親手實作經驗
ex: The job description requires at least three years of practical experience.
職位描述要求至少三年的實務經驗。
Internships allow students to gain valuable practical experience.
實習讓學生能獲得寶貴的實務經驗。
He lacks the practical experience needed for this managerial position.
他缺乏擔任此管理職位所需的實務經驗。

items.colloc: provide a price quote 提供報價 | request a price quote 要求報價
items.distinct: estimate 估價 | invoice 發票
ex: Please send us a price quote for the office renovation.
請寄給我們辦公室裝修的報價單。
We requested a formal price quote from three different suppliers.
我們向三家不同的供應商要求正式報價。
The price quote will remain valid for thirty days only.
此報價僅在三十天內有效。

items.colloc: work as a product designer 擔任產品設計師 | hire a product designer 聘請產品設計師
items.distinct: graphic designer 平面設計師 | interior designer 室內設計師
ex: The product designer created a sleek and modern laptop.
產品設計師設計了一款時尚且現代的筆記型電腦。
Our company is looking for an experienced product designer.
我們公司正在尋找一位有經驗的產品設計師。
The product designer collaborates closely with the engineering team.
產品設計師與工程團隊密切合作。

items.colloc: set up a product display 架設產品展示 | improve the product display 改進產品陳列
items.distinct: product launch 產品發表 | showroom 展示間
ex: The new product display caught the attention of many shoppers.
新的產品展示吸引了許多顧客的注意。
Retail staff must maintain a clean and attractive product display.
門市人員必須維持整潔且吸引人的商品陳列。
We decided to change the product display for the holiday season.
我們決定為節慶季節更改產品展示方式。

items.colloc: provide proof of employment 提供在職證明 | request proof of employment 要求工作證明
items.distinct: certificate of graduation 畢業證書 | transcript 成績單
ex: You need to submit a letter as proof of employment.
你需要提交一封信作為在職證明。
The bank requested proof of employment for the loan application.
銀行要求提供貸款申請的在職證明。
Human resources will issue your proof of employment tomorrow.
人力資源部明天會核發你的在職證明。

items.colloc: mark the property line 標示地界線 | cross the property line 越過地界線
items.distinct: boundary 界線 | border 國界；邊境
ex: The fence was built exactly on the property line.
圍籬正好建在土地界線上。
We need to survey the land to determine the property line.
我們需要測量土地以確定地界線。
Any construction must stay within the legal property line.
任何建築工程都必須保持在合法的土地範圍內。

days.theme: 教材片語・中高階 750–850 第 29 群

items.colloc: for public display 供公開展示 | public display of affection 公眾放閃
items.distinct: exhibition 展覽會 | demonstration 示範說明
ex: The artwork is now on public display at the lobby.
這件藝術品目前在大廳公開展示。
These documents are not for public display.
這些文件不適合對外公開展示。
He made a public display of his frustration.
他公開表現出了他的挫折感。

items.colloc: during a public holiday 在國定假日期間 | observe a public holiday 慶祝國定假日
items.distinct: vacation 個人假期 | day off 休假日
ex: The office will be closed on the public holiday.
辦公室將在國定假日當天關閉。
We usually travel abroad during the public holiday.
我們通常在國定假日期間出國旅遊。
Staff are entitled to pay for the public holiday.
員工有權領取國定假日的薪資。

items.colloc: pull up to the curb 靠邊停車 | pull up a chair 拉張椅子過來
items.distinct: stop 停止 | pull over 路邊停車
ex: Please pull up a chair and join the meeting.
請拉張椅子過來加入會議。
The delivery truck pulled up in front of the store.
貨車停在商店門口。
Management pulled him up for his frequent tardiness.
管理層因他頻繁遲到而糾正了他的行為。

items.colloc: gain market share 擴大市占率 | lose market share 失去市占率
items.distinct: market segment 市場區隔 | competitive advantage 競爭優勢
ex: The company aims to increase its market share by 5%.
公司目標是將市占率提升百分之五。
We are losing market share to new competitors.
我們正因新對手而流失市占率。
The firm holds the largest market share in the industry.
該公司擁有業界最大的市場佔有率。

items.colloc: put a rush on an order 訂單加急 | put a rush on the project 專案趕工
items.distinct: hurry up 趕快 | prioritize 優先處理
ex: Can you put a rush on this shipping request?
你能將這項運送請求加急處理嗎？
The client put a rush on the design document.
客戶要求這份設計文件加急。
We had to put a rush on the final production.
我們必須對最後生產階段進行趕工。

items.colloc: reach a record high 達到歷史新高 | hit a record high 創下最高紀錄
items.distinct: peak 頂峰 | all-time high 史上最高
ex: Inflation has reached a record high this quarter.
通貨膨脹在本季達到了歷史新高。
Our sales figures hit a record high in June.
我們的銷售額在六月創下歷史新高。
The stock price climbed to a record high today.
股價今日攀升至歷史新高。

items.colloc: write a reference letter 寫推薦信 | request a reference letter 要求推薦信
items.distinct: resume 履歷表 | recommendation 推薦
ex: She asked her former boss for a reference letter.
她向以前的老闆要求寫一封推薦信。
A strong reference letter can help you get hired.
強而有力的推薦信能幫你被錄取。
Please submit a reference letter with your application.
請在申請時附上一封推薦信。

items.colloc: postpone the release date 延後發布日期 | announce the release date 宣布上市日期
items.distinct: launch date 產品發表日 | deadline 截止日期
ex: The official release date of the game is Friday.
這款遊戲的正式發布日期是星期五。
We need to confirm the product release date soon.
我們需要盡快確認產品上市日期。
The release date was moved up to next week.
發布日期被提前到下週。

items.colloc: respond to an email 回覆郵件 | respond to a complaint 回應客訴
items.distinct: reply to 回覆 | react to 對...做出反應
ex: You should respond to his inquiry as soon as possible.
你應該盡快回應他的詢問。
The company responded to the crisis very quickly.
公司對這場危機的回應非常迅速。
Please respond to the invitation by tomorrow morning.
請在明天早上前回應這份邀請。

items.colloc: contribute to a retirement plan 存入退休金 | discuss a retirement plan 討論退休方案
items.distinct: pension 年金 | 401(k) 美國退休儲蓄計畫
ex: The company offers an excellent retirement plan.
公司提供了一項優渥的退休金方案。
I need to start contributing to my retirement plan.
我需要開始為我的退休計畫存錢。
She is reviewing her long-term retirement plan.
她正在檢視她長期的退休計畫。

items.colloc: promptly return a phone call 即時回電 | expect to return a phone call 等待回電
items.distinct: make a call 打電話 | call back 回撥
ex: I will return your phone call after the meeting.
會議結束後我會回覆你的電話。
He failed to return the phone call yesterday.
他昨天沒能回覆那通電話。
Make sure to return the phone call to the client.
務必記得回電給客戶。

items.colloc: cope with rising costs 應對成本上漲 | impact of rising costs 成本上升的影響
items.distinct: inflation 通貨膨脹 | price hike 價格猛漲
ex: We are struggling with the rising costs of raw materials.
我們正為了原物料成本上升而苦惱。
The rising costs are affecting our profit margins.
成本上升正影響著我們的利潤空間。
Management is looking for ways to cut rising costs.
管理層正在尋找削減成本上升的方法。

items.zh: 推出（新產品）；實施（新計畫）
items.colloc: roll out a new strategy 實施新策略 | roll out a product 推出新產品
items.distinct: launch 發表 | introduce 引進
ex: The company will roll out the new software next month.
公司將在下個月推出這款新軟體。
They are ready to roll out the marketing campaign.
他們準備好執行這項行銷活動了。
The new policy will be rolled out gradually.
這項新政策將會逐步實施。

items.colloc: book a round trip 預訂來回票 | round trip ticket 來回機票
items.distinct: one-way 單程 | transit 過境
ex: I bought a round trip ticket for the business trip.
我買了這次出差的來回機票。
The round trip takes about four hours in total.
整趟來回行程總共大約四小時。
We offer a discount on all round trip fares.
我們為所有往返票價提供折扣。

items.zh: 發起活動；執行廣告行銷
items.colloc: run a marketing campaign 進行行銷活動 | run a campaign for the project 為專案執行活動
items.distinct: launch a campaign 發起運動 | execute a plan 執行計畫
ex: They are running a campaign to promote the new model.
他們正在進行一項活動來推廣新機型。
We decided to run a campaign on social media.
我們決定在社群媒體上執行行銷活動。
The non-profit is running a campaign for donations.
該非營利組織正在發起一項捐款活動。

items.colloc: run an article in the paper 在報紙刊登文章 | run an article online 在線上發表文章
items.distinct: publish 出版 | print 印刷
ex: The magazine will run an article about our success.
這本雜誌將會刊登一篇關於我們成功的文章。
Did you see the article they ran in the news?
你有看到他們在新聞中報導的那篇文章嗎？
The editor decided to run an article on climate change.
編輯決定刊登一篇關於氣候變遷的文章。

items.pos: phr. 多頭馬車；無序發展
items.zh: 同時往多個方向進行；各自為政
items.colloc: projects run in several directions 專案多頭並進 | teams run in several directions 團隊各行其是
items.distinct: diversify 多元化 | diverge 分歧
ex: The project seems to be running in several directions at once.
這個專案看起來正處於多頭馬車的狀態。
When teams run in several directions, efficiency drops.
當團隊各自為政時，效率就會下降。
Our efforts shouldn't run in several directions simultaneously.
我們的努力不應該同時發散往多個方向。

items.colloc: run late for a meeting 會議遲到 | run late with a report 報告進度延誤
items.distinct: behind schedule 進度落後 | delayed 延遲
ex: I am running late for the morning conference call.
我早上那場電話會議要遲到了。
The train is running late due to bad weather.
因為天氣惡劣，火車誤點了。
We are running late with the quarterly report submission.
我們繳交季報的進度有些延誤。

items.colloc: run out of stock 庫存不足 | run out of time 時間用盡
items.distinct: consume 消耗 | deplete 用光
ex: We have run out of printer paper in the office.
辦公室的印表機紙張用完了。
We are running out of time to finish the task.
我們快沒時間完成這項任務了。
The company ran out of budget for the project.
公司為該專案準備的預算已經耗盡。

items.colloc: the first runner up 第一亞軍 | announce the runner up 宣布亞軍
items.distinct: winner 冠軍 | finalist 決賽入圍者
ex: The runner up received a certificate of achievement.
亞軍獲頒了一張成就證書。
We were the runner up in the annual design competition.
我們在年度設計競賽中獲得亞軍。
The runner up will be invited to the final ceremony.
亞軍將會受邀參加最後的頒獎典禮。

days.theme: 教材片語・中高階 750–850 第 30 群

items.colloc: annual sales figure 年度銷售額 | check the sales figure 檢查銷售數據
items.distinct: sales volume 銷售量 | sales revenue 銷售營收
ex: Please update the latest sales figure for the team.
請為團隊更新最新的銷售數據。
The sales figure for this quarter exceeded our expectations.
本季的銷售額超出了我們的預期。
Managers are reviewing the sales figure from last month.
經理們正在檢視上個月的銷售數據。

items.colloc: give a sales presentation 進行銷售簡報 | prepare a sales presentation 準備銷售簡報
items.distinct: marketing presentation 行銷簡報 | product demonstration 產品演示
ex: She gave a compelling sales presentation to the client.
她為客戶進行了一場引人入勝的銷售簡報。
We need to prepare a professional sales presentation today.
我們今天需要準備一份專業的銷售簡報。
The sales presentation focuses on our new service features.
這場銷售簡報著重於我們的新服務特色。

items.colloc: submit a sales report 提交銷售報告 | analyze the sales report 分析銷售報告
items.distinct: financial report 財務報告 | progress report 進度報告
ex: The sales report is due by the end of Friday.
銷售報告要在週五下班前繳交。
I have analyzed the monthly sales report for accuracy.
我已經分析過這份月度銷售報告的準確性。
Could you send me the sales report for this region?
你可以寄給我這區的銷售報告嗎？

items.colloc: consider the secondary effect 考慮次要影響 | mitigate the secondary effect 減輕次要影響
items.distinct: primary effect 主要影響 | side effect 副作用
ex: We must consider the secondary effect of this policy change.
我們必須考慮這項政策變動的次要影響。
The new tax law had a significant secondary effect on trade.
新稅法對貿易產生了顯著的間接影響。
They are investigating the secondary effect of the market slump.
他們正在調查市場蕭條的次要影響。

items.colloc: see if we can 看看我們是否能 | see if it is 看看它是否是
items.distinct: see whether 看看是否（較正式） | check if 確認是否
ex: Let me see if the manager is available now.
讓我看看經理現在是否有空。
I will see if we can finish the task early.
我會看看我們是否能提早完成這項任務。
He called to see if the shipment had arrived.
他打電話來看看貨物是否已經送達。

items.colloc: send off to the office 寄送到辦公室 | send off to the client 寄送給客戶
items.distinct: send out 發送 | ship to 運送至
ex: I will send off the contract to the legal department.
我會把合約寄送給法務部門。
Please send off the samples to our partner company.
請將樣品寄送給我們的合作公司。
The documents were sent off to the headquarters yesterday.
文件昨天已經寄送到總部了。

items.colloc: meet a senior executive 會見高階主管 | a senior executive decision 高階主管的決策
items.distinct: middle manager 中階主管 | junior staff 初階員工
ex: The senior executive will host the annual company meeting.
高階主管將主持年度公司會議。
She was promoted to a senior executive position last year.
她去年被晉升為高階主管職位。
We need approval from a senior executive for this budget.
這項預算需要高階主管的核准。

items.colloc: serve a customer promptly 迅速服務顧客 | serve a customer well 妥善服務顧客
items.distinct: assist a client 協助客戶 | handle a complaint 處理投訴
ex: Our staff are trained to serve a customer with care.
我們的員工受過訓練，能用心服務顧客。
It is important to serve a customer in a professional manner.
以專業的態度服務顧客是很重要的。
He is busy serving a customer at the front desk.
他正忙於在櫃檯服務顧客。

items.colloc: set aside funds 撥出資金 | set aside time 撥出時間
items.distinct: put aside 暫時放下 | reserve 預留
ex: We should set aside time to discuss the new strategy.
我們應該撥出時間來討論新策略。
The committee decided to set aside the proposal for now.
委員會決定暫時擱置這項提案。
They have set aside some money for emergency repairs.
他們已經撥出一筆錢用於緊急維修。

items.zh: 開始工作；定下心來工作
items.colloc: set down to work immediately 立即開始工作 | set down to work on the project 開始處理專案
items.distinct: get down to work 開始著手工作 | start working 開始工作
ex: It is time to set down to work on the monthly report.
是時候定下心來處理月度報告了。
They set down to work as soon as the meeting ended.
會議一結束，他們就開始著手工作。
We need to set down to work to meet the deadline.
為了趕上截止日期，我們必須開始認真工作。

items.colloc: set the table for dinner 為晚餐擺放餐具 | help set the table 幫忙擺放餐具
items.distinct: clear the table 收拾餐桌 | arrange the table 安排座位
ex: The waiter is setting the table for the business lunch.
服務生正在為商務午餐擺放餐具。
Please help me set the table before the guests arrive.
請在客人抵達前幫我擺放餐具。
They set the table with fine china for the banquet.
他們為宴會擺放了精緻瓷器餐具。

items.colloc: set up a business 創業 | set up a meeting 安排會議
items.distinct: establish 建立（機構） | arrange 安排（行程）
ex: They plan to set up a new branch in Taipei.
他們計劃在台北設立一家新分公司。
I will set up a conference call for tomorrow morning.
我會為明天早上安排一場電話會議。
The IT department helped set up the new software.
資訊部門協助安裝了新軟體。

items.colloc: successfully set up an interview 成功安排面試 | help set up an interview 協助安排面試
items.distinct: arrange an interview 安排面試 | conduct an interview 進行面試
ex: Human resources will set up an interview with the candidate.
人資部門將會與候選人安排面試。
I managed to set up an interview for next Wednesday.
我設法安排了下週三的面試。
Please set up an interview as soon as you receive the resume.
收到履歷後請儘快安排面試。

items.colloc: like to show off 喜歡炫耀 | show off their skills 炫耀他們的技能
items.distinct: boast 自誇 | display 展示
ex: He likes to show off his expensive office equipment.
他喜歡炫耀他昂貴的辦公設備。
There is no need to show off during the presentation.
簡報時不需要刻意賣弄。
She showed off her new marketing strategy to the team.
她向團隊展示了她新的行銷策略。

items.colloc: take sick leave 請病假 | on sick leave 請病假中
items.distinct: annual leave 年假 | personal leave 事假
ex: He is on sick leave for the rest of the week.
他這週剩下的時間都在請病假。
Please submit your sick leave application through the portal.
請透過系統提交您的病假申請。
She had to take sick leave due to a sudden illness.
由於突發疾病，她必須請病假。

items.colloc: work side by side 並肩工作 | sit side by side 並排坐
items.distinct: together 一起 | alongside 在旁邊
ex: Our departments will work side by side on this project.
我們的部門將會並肩合作完成這個專案。
The two companies are working side by side to innovate.
這兩家公司正並肩合作進行創新。
They sat side by side to review the legal documents.
他們並排坐著審閱法律文件。

items.colloc: unexpected side effect 意想不到的副作用 | manage the side effect 管理副作用
items.distinct: consequence 後果 | secondary effect 次要影響
ex: The new policy had an unintended side effect on morale.
新政策對士氣產生了非預期的副作用。
We must evaluate every potential side effect of this plan.
我們必須評估這項計畫的每一個潛在副作用。
The drug has a mild side effect on some patients.
該藥物對一些病人有輕微的副作用。

items.colloc: sign up for a course 報名課程 | sign up for the newsletter 訂閱電子報
items.distinct: register for 註冊 | enroll in 註冊入學/課程
ex: Many employees signed up for the leadership training program.
許多員工報名參加了領導力培訓計畫。
You can sign up for the seminar on the website.
你可以在網站上報名參加研討會。
She signed up for the newsletter to get industry updates.
她訂閱了電子報以獲取產業最新消息。

items.pos: phr. 耐著性子看完/坐完
items.zh: 耐著性子看完；坐著聽完
items.colloc: sit through a meeting 坐著聽完會議 | sit through the lecture 聽完講座
items.distinct: attend 參加 | endure 忍受
ex: It is difficult to sit through such a long presentation.
要耐著性子聽完這麼長的簡報很困難。
I had to sit through three hours of budget reviews.
我不得不耐著性子參加了三個小時的預算審查。
Everyone had to sit through the boring safety video.
每個人都得耐著性子看完那部無聊的安全影片。

items.colloc: speak on the phone briefly 簡短通話 | speak on the phone about the deal 通電話討論交易
items.distinct: talk on the phone 講電話 | call someone 打電話給某人
ex: I will speak on the phone with the client later.
我稍後會與客戶通電話。
He is busy speaking on the phone regarding the contract.
他正忙著就合約事宜通電話。
We often speak on the phone to coordinate our schedules.
我們常通電話來協調彼此的行程。

days.theme: 教材片語・中高階 750–850 第 31 群

items.colloc: form a line 排隊 | wait in a line 在隊伍中等待
items.distinct: stand in line 美式用法 | queue up 英式用法
ex: Please stand in a line at the counter.
請在櫃台前排成一列。
The customers stand in a line for coffee.
顧客們排成一列等咖啡。
Workers must stand in a line for inspection.
員工必須排成一列接受檢查。

items.colloc: stand in line for hours 排隊數小時 | stand in line to enter 排隊進場
items.distinct: stand in a line 排成隊形 | line up 排隊
ex: I had to stand in line for twenty minutes.
我不得不排隊二十分鐘。
Employees stand in line to register at events.
員工排隊在活動現場簽到。
Do not stand in line near the emergency exit.

items.distinct: leave a message 留下訊息 | send a message 發送訊息

items.colloc: take immediate action 立即採取行動 | take legal action 採取法律行動
items.distinct: make a move 開始行動 | carry out 執行

items.pos: phr. 感到非常高興；引以為樂
items.colloc: take great pleasure in doing sth. 樂於做某事 | take great pleasure in helping 以助人為樂
items.distinct: be pleased to 很高興能 | feel honored 感到榮幸

我們的業務代表現在會處理這筆訂單。

items.distinct: concise 簡潔的 | irrelevant 不相關的

試著讓你的報告簡明扼要。

items.colloc: obey the traffic signal 遵守交通號誌 | ignore the traffic signal 闖紅燈

十字路口的交通號誌壞了。
He turned left after the traffic signal changed.
交通號誌變換後他便左轉。

items.distinct: at the moment 此刻 | for a moment 片刻
ex: The meeting will begin in a moment.
會議馬上就要開始了。
I will be with you in a moment, sir.
先生，我馬上就來協助您。
We will have the results in a moment.
我們很快就會有結果了。

items.colloc: in a pile of papers 一堆文件中 | leave in a pile 堆放在一起
items.distinct: in a stack 疊放 | in a heap 堆積
ex: There are files in a pile on my desk.
我的桌上有一堆文件。
Please do not leave inventory in a pile.
請不要將庫存隨意堆放。
I found the mail in a pile by the door.
我在門邊發現一堆郵件。

items.colloc: in flight service 機上服務 | in flight entertainment 機上娛樂
items.distinct: on board 在飛機上 | during the flight 在飛行期間
ex: The flight attendant served drinks in flight.
空服員在飛行中提供了飲料。
The in-flight entertainment system is broken.
機上娛樂系統壞掉了。
We experienced some turbulence while in flight.
我們在飛行途中遇到了亂流。

items.colloc: be in luck today 今天很走運 | if you are in luck 如果你運氣好
items.distinct: good luck 好運 | out of luck 倒楣
ex: You are in luck, we have one left.
你運氣真好，我們還剩最後一個。
We were in luck to find an open store.
我們很幸運找到一家還在營業的店。
If you are in luck, you will get the promotion.
如果你運氣好的話，就會升職。

items.pos: phr. 就位；準備就緒；適當的
items.colloc: have a system in place 建立制度 | everything in place 一切就緒
items.distinct: in position 在位置上 | out of place 不適當
ex: We have safety measures in place now.
我們現在已經採取了安全措施。
Make sure all documents are in place.
確保所有文件都準備就緒。
The new policy will be in place next month.
新政策將於下個月開始實施。

days.theme: 教材片語・中高階 750–850 第 36 群

items.colloc: in summary, we... 總結來說，我們... | to be in summary 簡而言之
items.distinct: in conclusion 結論是 | in brief 簡言之
ex: In summary, the quarterly performance met our expectations.
總結來說，本季績效符合我們的預期。
The manager provided a report in summary of the meeting.
經理提供了會議的總結報告。
In summary, we need to reduce operational costs immediately.
總結來說，我們需要立即降低營運成本。

items.colloc: act in turn 輪流行動 | in turn, affect... 進而影響...
items.distinct: by turns 輪流 | one by one 一個接一個
ex: High inflation, in turn, led to lower consumer spending.
高通貨膨脹進而導致了消費支出減少。
Each department head spoke in turn at the meeting.
會議中各部門主管輪流發言。
Improved efficiency will, in turn, increase our profit margins.
效率提升將相應地增加我們的利潤率。

items.colloc: excellent job opportunity 極佳的工作機會 | offer a job opportunity 提供工作機會
items.distinct: career prospect 職涯前景 | job opening 職缺
ex: This position is a great job opportunity for young graduates.
這個職位對於剛畢業的學生來說是很好的工作機會。
The company posted a new job opportunity on its website.
該公司在網站上發佈了一則新職缺。
He is seeking a job opportunity that offers international travel.
他正在尋找一個能有出差機會的工作。

items.colloc: start a job search 開始求職 | during the job search 在求職期間
items.distinct: job hunting 求職活動 | career development 職涯發展
ex: The job search process can be both challenging and rewarding.
求職過程既充滿挑戰又有所收穫。
She is focusing her job search on the technology sector.
她將求職重點放在科技業。
Networking is essential for a successful job search.
人脈對於成功的求職至關重要。

items.colloc: qualified job seeker 合格的求職者 | active job seeker 主動求職者
items.distinct: applicant 申請人 | candidate 候選人
ex: Every job seeker should tailor their resume to the company.
每位求職者都應針對公司客製化履歷。
The website provides resources for the modern job seeker.
該網站為現代求職者提供資源。
Many a job seeker struggles with the initial interview phase.
許多求職者都在面試初期階段感到困難。

items.colloc: keep track of expenses 記錄費用 | keep track of time 掌握時間
items.distinct: lose track of 忘記/失去聯繫 | record 記錄（動詞）
ex: You should keep track of all your billable hours.
你應該記錄下所有可收費的工作時數。
It is difficult to keep track of multiple ongoing projects.
要追蹤多個進行中的專案相當困難。
The software helps managers keep track of inventory levels.
該軟體協助經理追蹤庫存水準。

items.colloc: lean back in the chair 坐在椅子上向後靠 | lean back and relax 往後靠並放鬆
items.distinct: lean forward 向前傾 | recline 斜倚
ex: He likes to lean back while reviewing the financial reports.
他喜歡在檢閱財務報表時向後靠。
Please lean back and wait for the meeting to start.
請向後靠並等待會議開始。
She leaned back to consider the proposal more carefully.
她向後靠著以便更仔細地考慮這個提案。

items.colloc: light weight design 輕量化設計 | light weight material 輕量材質
items.distinct: lightweight（形容詞）輕的 | heavy duty 重型的
ex: This laptop is popular because of its light weight design.
這款筆電因其輕量化設計而廣受歡迎。
The team developed a light weight solution for portable devices.
該團隊為攜帶式裝置開發了輕量化解決方案。
These light weight crates are easier to move around the warehouse.
這些輕量貨箱更容易在倉庫內搬運。

items.colloc: show a lack of confidence 表現出缺乏信心 | suffer from a lack of confidence 因缺乏信心而苦惱
items.distinct: lack of confidence (拼寫修正) | low self-esteem 自尊心低
ex: The applicant showed a lack of confidence during the interview.
申請人在面試時表現出缺乏信心。
Lack of confidence can hinder your professional growth.
缺乏信心會阻礙你的職涯成長。
The team’s lack of confidence resulted in poor project results.
團隊缺乏信心導致了糟糕的專案成果。

items.pos: phr. 第一線員工；作業員
items.colloc: experienced line worker 資深作業員 | train line workers 訓練作業員
items.distinct: staff 職員 | executive 主管
ex: The line worker reported a safety issue to the supervisor.
作業員向主管報告了一項安全問題。
Our line workers are highly skilled in assembly techniques.
我們的作業員在組裝技術上非常熟練。
New line workers must complete a mandatory training program.
新進作業員必須完成強制性訓練計畫。

items.colloc: look for a job 尋找工作 | look for evidence 尋找證據
items.distinct: search for 搜索 | seek 尋求
ex: We are looking for a candidate with strong leadership skills.
我們正在尋找一位具備強大領導能力的候選人。
Management is looking for ways to cut unnecessary costs.
管理層正在尋找削減不必要成本的方法。
The marketing department is looking for new advertising channels.
行銷部門正在尋找新的廣告通路。

items.colloc: look into the matter 調查該事項 | look into the possibility 研究可能性
items.distinct: investigate 調查 | explore 探索
ex: The board will look into the causes of the decline.
董事會將調查業績下滑的原因。
We need to look into the new tax regulations carefully.
我們需要仔細研究新的稅務法規。
I will look into whether we have enough budget remaining.
我會去查一下我們是否還有足夠的預算。

items.colloc: look out for opportunities 留意機會 | look out for safety 留意安全
items.distinct: watch out 警戒 | beware 嚴防
ex: Look out for any errors in the final contract draft.
留意最終合約草案中的任何錯誤。
Investors should look out for signs of market volatility.
投資人應留意市場波動的跡象。
You must look out for your colleagues' safety in the factory.
你必須在工廠裡留意同事的安全。

items.colloc: look over the documents 檢查文件 | look over the proposal 審閱提案
items.distinct: look through 詳閱 | review 審核
ex: Please look over the report before the afternoon meeting.
請在下午開會前瀏覽一下這份報告。
He took a moment to look over the financial statements.
他花了一點時間檢查財務報表。
Could you look over my presentation slides for any typos?
你可以幫我檢查一下簡報投影片有沒有錯字嗎？

items.zh: 失去優勢；地位下滑；衰退
items.colloc: lose ground to competitors 輸給競爭對手 | start to lose ground 開始失勢
items.distinct: fall behind 落後 | lose advantage 失去優勢
ex: The company began to lose ground in the local market.
該公司開始在當地市場失去競爭優勢。
Our brand is losing ground to more innovative competitors.
我們的品牌正輸給更具創新力的對手。
We cannot afford to lose ground in this key industry.
在這個關鍵產業中，我們承受不起地位下滑的後果。

items.colloc: lose oneself in work 沉浸於工作中 | lose oneself in a task 埋首於任務
items.distinct: immerse in 沉浸於 | focus on 專注於
ex: He often loses himself in complex data analysis tasks.
他經常埋首於複雜的數據分析任務中。
She tends to lose herself in projects that require creativity.
她傾向於沉浸在需要創造力的專案中。
It is easy to lose oneself in the details of the budget.
人很容易沉浸在預算的細節中而忽略重點。

items.colloc: the package was lost in delivery 包裹在運送中遺失 | report an item lost in delivery 回報物品運送遺失
items.distinct: delayed in transit 運送延遲 | undelivered 未送達
ex: The client claimed that the parcel was lost in delivery.
客戶聲稱包裹在運送過程中遺失了。
We apologize that your order was lost in delivery.
我們很抱歉您的訂單在運送中遺失。
Check the tracking status if your shipment is lost in delivery.
如果您的貨物在運送中遺失，請檢查追蹤狀態。

items.colloc: maintain loyal customers 維持忠實客戶 | reward a loyal customer 獎勵忠實客戶
items.distinct: repeat customer 回頭客 | regular client 常客
ex: We offer special discounts to every loyal customer.
我們為每位忠實客戶提供特別折扣。
Keeping a loyal customer is cheaper than finding a new one.
留住忠實客戶比開發新客戶成本更低。
The company’s growth depends on its base of loyal customers.
該公司的成長取決於其忠實客戶群。

items.colloc: make a call to the office 打電話到辦公室 | make a tough call 做出艱難決定
items.distinct: make a decision 做決定 | telephone 打電話
ex: I need to make a call to confirm the meeting time.
我需要打通電話確認會議時間。
The manager had to make a tough call regarding budget cuts.
經理必須針對預算削減做出艱難的決定。
She will make a call about the project direction today.
她今天會針對專案方向做出決定。

items.colloc: make a commitment to quality 致力於品質 | make a commitment to the team 對團隊做出承諾
items.distinct: devote to 奉獻於 | promise to 答應
ex: The company made a commitment to sustainable business practices.
公司承諾採取永續的商業模式。
We must make a commitment to improving our customer service.
我們必須致力於改善客戶服務。
He made a commitment to finishing the report by Friday.
他承諾會在週五前完成報告。
